title: Shopify Ecommerce Operations Manager — Clothing Brand
description:
We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer fashion brand based in Europe doing ~€250K/month in revenue and scaling toward €1M/month. We need ONE smart, ownership-minded operations manager to run the day-to-day so the founder can focus on growth. This is a long-term role, not a project.



You'll be the right hand running the store. If you're a junior VA looking to do data entry, this isn't the role. If you've managed a real Shopify business end-to-end and want to grow with one, keep reading.



--- WHAT YOU'LL OWN DAY-TO-DAY ---



STORE OPERATIONS



- Confirm every order older than 72h is fulfilled and chase what isn't with our supplier

- Pay supplier invoices on a recurring schedule

- Monitor Shopify Payments / Stripe payouts and flag anomalies

- Maintain our supplier product list



CUSTOMER SERVICE



- Clear the inbox to zero by 6 PM CET every day with the help of AI

- Reply to standard tickets using our existing playbook (AI drafts most replies — you approve / edit / send)

- Escalate refund / return / chargeback threats to the founder with a one-line summary

- Weekly: report top 3 complaint themes



DAILY REPORTING



- Update a performance dashboard with yesterday's revenue, orders, ad spend, ROAS

- Spot anomalies and flag them by 10 AM every morning



META ADS



- Track daily ad spend and pause underperforming ads (rule-based — you execute, you don't optimize from scratch)

- Brief and submit 1 new ad concept per day to the creative team



INSTAGRAM CONTENT (Canva + CapCut workflow)



- Post 3 pieces of content per day using our templates

- Post and review IG Stories

- Scrape and save inspiration from a curated list of competitor accounts

- Delete negative / spam comments



WEEKLY LAUNCHES



- Coordinate weekly product launches: assets ready, product page live,
 + social scheduled



MONTHLY / PROJECT WORK



- Plan one 12-post photoshoot per month

- Help recruit additional creative tea
mbers



--- REQUIRED SKILLS (must-have, do not apply without these) ---



- 3+ years managing a Shopify store doing $500K+/year

- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager — you can read a campaign and tell me if it's healthy

- Front, Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar CS tool

- Canva + CapCut proficiency (we'll see your work in the application)

- Excellent written English (you reply to customers)

- Comfortable with a Notion-based task system

- Available 9 AM – 6 PM CET (Europe time, roughly 3 PM – 12 AM Manila)



--- NICE-TO-HAVE ---

- French language

- Experience with clothing brands

- Klaviyo /
 marketing



--- COMPENSATION ---



$900/month for the first 30-day paid trial. Bumps to $1,100–1,300/month after a successful trial, based on demonstrated skill. Plus 13th-month and a performance bonus tied to monthly revenue growth.



--- TO APPLY, SEND ME ---



1. Your most recent Shopify store you managed (URL + your role)

2. A 1-minute Loom walking through how you'd handle this scenario: a customer messages at 5:55 PM saying "Where's my order #1234? I want a refund." Talk through what you'd check and how you'd reply.

3. Your salary expectation.

4. The word hello at the top of your reply so I know you read this whole post.



Applications without all four will be ignored.

title: Personal Injury Intake Specialist (Remote)
description:
Personal Injury Intake Specialist (Remote)



Crooks Law Firm | Full-Time | 100% Remote



About the Role



We're a personal injury law firm looking for an experienced Intake Specialist to be the first voice a potential client hears. People call us on what is often the worst week of their life — after a car wreck, a fall, a workplace injury. Your job is to make them feel heard, get the facts we need, and move qualified cases into our pipeline quickly and cleanly.



This is a fully remote position. You'll need a quiet home workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and the discipline to stay productive without someone looking over your shoulder.



What You'll Do

Answer inbound calls, web form submissions, chats, and texts from potential clients — usually within minutes, not hours

Conduct compassionate but thorough intake interviews: how the injury happened, treatment received, insurance coverage, police reports, witnesses, prior claims

Screen cases against our firm's criteria and escalate strong leads to an attorney the same day

Follow up persistently on leads that don't sign on the first contact — most cases are won or lost in the follow-up

Send, track, and chase down retainer agreements and HIPAA authorizations through e-signature

Enter and maintain accurate, detailed records in our case management system (Filevine / Litify / Clio or similar)

Politely decline and refer out cases that aren't a fit, without burning the relationship

Hit response-time, contact-attempt, and conversion benchmarks tracked weekly

What You Need

1–3 years of intake experience at a personal injury firm (or a legal call center handling PI leads)

Working knowledge of PI basics: statutes of limitation, liability vs. damages, UM/UIM, med pay, letters of protection

Genuine phone presence — warm, calm, and able to control a conversation with an upset or rambling caller

Strong typing and note-taking; you can capture a full intake while staying engaged on the call

Comfort with case management software, e-signature platforms, and CRM/lead tracking

Home office with a quiet, private space and reliable internet

Availability to work our core business hours, with occasional evening or weekend rotation for after-hours leads

Preferred

Bilingual — fluent in Spanish and English (spoken and written)

Experience with high-volume advertising-driven lead flow

Familiarity with medical terminology and treatment timelines

Why Work Here

Fully remote, with equipment provided

Direct impact — you're the reason a case gets signed, not a cog three departments away

Small enough that your ideas about improving intake actually get implemented

Health, PTO, and paid holidays

How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note about the highest-volume intake role you've held — how many leads a day, and what your sign rate looked like. If you're bilingual, tell us how you've used Spanish in a professional legal setting.



Crooks Law Firm is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: TikTok Organic Follower Growth
description:
Hi, I want to launch a brand-new faceless TikTok account and I'm looking for someone experienced in organic TikTok growth and short-form content creation.



My goal is to build the account from zero to at least 5,000-6,000 real, engaged followers so that the account can qualify for UGC/brand opportunities.



I'm not expecting this to happen overnight. I'm looking for someone who understands that this may take several months and can consistently produce content designed to grow the account organically.



What I'm looking for:



* Researching content ideas and trends within the niche

* Developing a repeatable TikTok content strategy

* Creating/editing the videos for me

* Sending me finished videos that are ready to post

* Writing hooks, captions, and suggested hashtags/keywords

* Testing different video styles and formats

* Reviewing performance and adjusting the strategy based on what works

* Growing the account through legitimate organic methods only



The account will be completely faceless, so the content needs to work without me appearing on camera.



I would handle posting the videos unless you believe there is a specific reason you should manage posting as well.



Before hiring, I'd like to know:



1. Have you grown TikTok accounts organically before?

2. Can you show examples of accounts you've worked on and their growth?

3. Approximately how many videos would you recommend posting per week?

4. Would you personally create the videos, or would someone else on your team create them?

5. What would you need from me to produce the content?

6. What would your monthly price be for this service?

7. How would you measure whether the account is progressing successfully?

8. What would your strategy be for the first 30 days?



I'm looking for someone I can potentially work with long term if the account is consistently growing and the content quality is strong.



Please include examples of your previous TikTok work when you respond.

$5.00/hour + Performance Bonus



Full-Time | Remote



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



About the Role:

Dubin Law Group is seeking an Insurance Claims Specialist to support our Case Management team by handling insurance claims, policy verification, and insurance-related case setup for personal injury matters.



This role is heavily focused on communicating with insurance carriers, obtaining policy information, verifying coverage, requesting documentation, and ensuring cases are set up accurately from the beginning.

•Maintain organized and accurate case records within Filevine

•Communicate insurance updates to Case Managers and attorneys

•Monitor assigned tasks and ensure timely completion of insurance-related requests

•Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously

•Ability to work independently in a remote environment

•Personal injury law firm experience

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.



To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items



1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you are the person we are looking for.



2. Your current résumé.



3. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service, inside sales, office administration, or social media experience.



4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part time schedule and transition into the required full time Mountain Time schedule.



5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.



6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule.



8. Your brief answer to this question:



A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next?



Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them.



Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Best,



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

## Schedule and pay



- Part-time, ongoing retainer with consistent weekly work

- Timezone overlap with Sydney, Australia is required (we are 2 to 3 hours ahead of Philippine time, so this is an easy overlap)

Start your message with the word **VOLTAGE** so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be opened.



Then send:



1. **2 to 3 live Elementor sites you built** (links, not screenshots). Trades or local service examples preferred.

title: Graphic Designer (Web Design + Ad Creative)
description:
About the Role



We are an SEO agency serving local service businesses and ecommerce brands across the US. We are hiring a full-time Graphic Designer who can build beautiful, conversion-focused websites and brand assets for our clients, with SEO built into every page from the start rather than bolted on afterward.



This is not a "make it pretty" design role. You will be building real pages, mainly on WordPress with some Wix and Squarespace, that are designed to rank and convert. You will also create ad creative for paid campaigns and support our internal marketing materials.



If you like ownership, variety, and seeing your work drive actual results for real businesses, this is a good fit.



What You'll Own



1. Client Website and Page Design



Design and build client website pages on WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace

Structure pages with SEO fundamentals in mind: heading hierarchy, image optimization, page speed, mobile responsiveness, and internal linking opportunities

Mock up new website designs for existing clients and for new SEO sites

Work from client briefs and brand direction to create pages that look professional and turn visitors into leads



2. Ad Creative



Create ad graphics for paid campaigns, including static display ads, social ad creative, and multiple variations for A/B testing. Work on campaign creative, which means you should be comfortable taking direction and turning around several concepts quickly.



3. Brand Guidelines and Identity



Build brand guideline documents for new clients as they onboard, covering color palettes, typography, logo usage, and voice and tone direction. Create brand systems from scratch for companies that do not have one. Keep every page and asset we produce for a client visually consistent.



4. Speed and Systems



Use automation and AI tools to build pages faster. We are not looking for someone who designs every page by hand from scratch. We want someone who builds reusable templates and components, works efficiently inside page builders and automation tools, and is always looking for ways to cut production time without cutting quality.



5. Internal Design



Support internal marketing design, including social graphics, ad creative, presentation decks, and sales materials

Help keep the brand sharp across every touchpoint.



What We Need From You

- Several years of real design experience. Not a beginner, and not "I took a course." We need someone who has actually shipped client work.

- A portfolio you can show us. This is required with your application, not optional. No portfolio, no consideration.

- Strong working knowledge of WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace page building

- A practical understanding of on-page SEO. You do not need to be a technical SEO expert, but you should know why heading structure, alt text, and page speed matter.

- Hands-on experience with automation, AI design tools, or templating systems to speed up output. Tell us specifically which tools you use and how they have cut your turnaround time.

- Confidence building brand guidelines from scratch for a brand new client

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Add design26 to your application to be considered

- Reliable, deadline-driven, and able to manage several client projects at once



Bonus Skills



- Shopify store design and theme customization

- Logo design for clients who need one built from the ground up

- Familiarity with Claude's AI design features as part of your workflow



Schedule and Pay



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Base Pay: $1,000 per month



Bonuses on top of base for:

- Client retention

- Completed tasks and fast project turnaround

- Exceptional work quality

- Shopify design projects

- Use of Claude's AI design tools in your workflow



How to Apply



Send all of the following:

- Your resume or CV

- Your design portfolio, with the link included directly in your application

- A short cover note explaining why you are a strong fit for this specific role

- A section titled "Why I Stand Out." This is your chance to show us what separates you from every other applicant. Be specific, be confident, and point us to your best work.



Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.



By applying, you consent to us reviewing your portfolio and application materials, and contacting any references you provide.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. Real client work, real creative ownership, and a clear path to more responsibility and more pay as you prove yourself.

title: Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist – Medicaid / Claims Experience Required
description:
Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist – Medicaid / Claims Experience Required



Remote | Philippines | Full-Time | Long-Term Position | U.S.-Based Home Care Agency



About Us



Zeabe is a U.S.-based non-medical Home Care Agency serving clients in Delaware.



We are looking for an experienced Home Care Billing & Payroll Specialist to take ownership of key billing, claims, accounts receivable, authorization, and payroll processes.



This is not a general virtual assistant, bookkeeping, or data-entry role.



We need someone who understands that billing does not end when a claim is submitted.



If a claim should have paid $1,000 and only $700 was received, we expect you to determine why, correct the issue, and follow it through until it is resolved.



Work Schedule

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week

Remote from the Philippines

Night shift aligned substantially with U.S. Eastern Time business hours 8am to 4:30pm EST

Permanent, long-term position



Key Responsibilities

Home Care Billing & Claims

Finalize billing cycles and review billable visits before claims are generated.

Submit and monitor electronic healthcare claims.

Investigate rejected, denied, unpaid, partially paid, and underpaid claims.

Correct, adjust, or resubmit claims where required.

Reconcile expected reimbursement against actual payments received.

Follow outstanding claims through to final resolution.

Medicaid & VA Billing



You will work with payers including:



AmeriHealth Caritas Delaware

Highmark Health Options

Delaware First Health

U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs



Responsibilities include reviewing authorizations, hours, units, rates, service dates, payer requirements, and resolving billing discrepancies.



Previous Medicaid Managed Care or VA billing experience is highly desirable.



Accounts Receivable

Review ERA/EOB information and reconcile payments.

Monitor AR aging and unpaid claims.

Investigate underpayments and payment discrepancies.

Follow up on outstanding balances and payer issues.

Payroll

Prepare and process caregiver and office payroll.

Reconcile worked hours against payable hours.

Review rates, PTO, bonuses, adjustments, and other payroll items.

Investigate discrepancies before payroll is finalized.



Required Experience



We are looking for approximately 4+ years of relevant billing or claims experience in one or more of the following:



U.S. Home Care billing

U.S. Home Health billing

Medicaid billing

Medicare billing

U.S. healthcare revenue cycle or claims management



Home Care or Home Health billing experience is strongly preferred.



Your experience should include working claims after submission, including areas such as:



Rejections and denials

Partial payments and underpayments

Corrected or adjusted claims

ERA/EOB reconciliation

AR follow-up



If your billing experience stops once a claim has been submitted, this is probably not the right role.



Strongly Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:



Medicaid Managed Care Organizations

VA billing

Waystar or another healthcare clearinghouse

AlayaCare or another Home Care platform

Payer portals

Payroll for hourly or field-based employees

QuickBooks

BambooHR



We can train you on our specific systems. What matters most is that you already understand healthcare billing, claims investigation, and financial reconciliation.



You May Be a Great Fit If...

You notice when numbers do not reconcile.

An unexplained $37 difference bothers you until you understand it.

You enjoy investigating why something happened.

You like closing open loops.

You naturally double-check important work.

You prefer accuracy over simply getting something off your desk.

You work well independently and follow structured processes.

You take responsibility for the final outcome, not just your part of the process.

This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If...



Your experience is mainly:



General virtual assistance

Data entry

Basic bookkeeping

Accounts payable

Payroll without healthcare billing experience

Administrative support

Claim entry without responsibility for denials, AR, or payment resolution

Technical Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet

Quiet home workspace

Reliable computer

Working headset and webcam

Reliable availability during scheduled hours



Backup power and internet are strongly preferred.



What We Value



We value people who:



Own the Outcome

Get It Done

Choose Clarity Over Ambiguity

Fix the System

Stay Curious

Compensation



USD $1,400–$1,800 per month, depending on directly relevant U.S. Home Care, Medicaid, VA, billing, claims, and payroll experience.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters, starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role:



Billing & Payroll



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

s per day, and one result you're proud of — with the actual number.

title: Short Form Video Editor (AI Generation/Sneakers/Nike)
description:
WHAT THIS ROLE IS



I run a content brand built around the niche of Sneakers in short-form video — reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. I need a dedicated editor who can take raw footage and turn it into fast, polished videos that feel native to the platform. Pacing, hooks, sound design, and audience retention matter more here than fancy effects. If you've only edited long-form or corporate content, this probably isn't the right fit.



---



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Edit raw footage into short-form videos (15–90 sec) optimized for reels and TikTok

- Curate AI video generation clips. You will filter out which AI clips are good, and bad.

- Handle cuts, captions, editing with the videos

- Adapt quickly to new topics and content styles as the brand evolves

- Bonus: write or refine scripts — hooks, transitions, CTAs

- Bonus: experience with AI video generation tools (Runway, Kling, Pika, CapCut AI, etc.)

- HIGH BONUS: Understand the nature of Sneakers, SNKRS, Nike, Sneaker Reselling, Hyped Sneaker Colorways, Etc



---



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years editing short-form content professionally (not just personal projects)

- Proficient in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve — provable in your portfolio

- Strong sense of pacing and what keeps viewers watching past the first 3 seconds

- Reliable internet, consistent power, and a schedule that overlaps with US Central Time

- Clear written English — you need to communicate async without needing to be chased

- Portfolio of 5+ short-form videos you personally edited (required — no portfolio = no review)

-BONUS: Good understanding of the Sneaker Industry (Nike, Adidas, Jordans, SNKRS, etc)



---



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a generic cover letter. Answer all three questions below. Applications that skip questions or don't include a portfolio link will not be opened.



Share a Google Drive or YouTube link to at least 3 short-form videos you personally edited. For each video, write 1–2 sentences explaining your specific contribution — did you script it? Handle audio? Do the captions? Be specific. Do not link a general website or Instagram page — link the actual videos.



Why should you work for us? Describe yourself, your work ethic, and clear examples how you can make that up.



---



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Qualified applicants will receive a paid trial edit — one raw clip, your cut, compensated. If it's a match, we move to a 30-day trial and then long-term. I give direct feedback, consistent work, and pay on time every time. This is a 1:1 role — you work directly with me, not through an agency or middleman.



For any questions, message me under this application.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels & TikTok (Beauty / Aesthetics Niche)
description:
We're launching a new direct-to-consumer beauty / aesthetics service targeting European markets (France, Poland, Spain, Italy). Our growth engine is short-form video on Instagram Reels + TikTok — high-volume, fast-iteration content modeled on accounts that have proven the format in this niche.



We need a video editor who can produce 3–5 polished reels per week in our brand template. You'll work from raw footage + b-roll + brand assets that we provide. Your job is to assemble, pace, and finish the cut: text overlays, motion graphics, captions, sound design, color.



You'll edit ONE master reel per concept, then produce localized variants by swapping text layers and audio (we supply translations + AI-generated voiceovers via ElevenLabs / DeepL / Submagic). The editing template is built once, then re-skinned 4 times.



--- WHAT YOU'LL DO ---



EDITING

- 3–5 reels per week, 15–60 seconds each

- Cut to trending audio + hooks designed to retain viewers in the first 0.5 second

- Motion graphics: text reveals, side-by-side comparisons, zoom-in highlights, arrow callouts, ratio overlays

- Color grade and sound design to a consistent brand look

- Build Premiere templates so locale variants take under 20 minutes each



LOCALIZATION WORKFLOW

- Take 1 master edit and output 4 localized variants (French / Polish / Spanish / Italian)

- Swap text overlays from a translation sheet we supply

- Replace voiceover track with locale-appropriate AI audio we provide

- QC each variant for timing, kerning, and line-breaks per language (text length varies)



ASSET MANAGEMENT

- Organize project files in a clean folder structure (Google Drive)

- Maintain a "concept library" of reusable templates

- Tag and archive raw footage so we can repurpose later



FEEDBACK LOOP

- Light weekly analytics review: which hooks / edits get the most retention

- Iterate the template based on what's working



--- REQUIRED SKILLS (must-have — do not apply without these) ---

- 2+ years editing short-form social video (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)

- Strong CapCut AND Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve / After Effects)

- Motion graphics: text animation, masks, keyframe tracking

- Comfortable working from a brand style guide (fonts, colors, beat timing)

- Fast turnaround: you can deliver a finished reel in under 4 hours from raw footage

- Functional written English — enough to read briefs and reply with questions. Doesn't have to be fluent; we use translation tools both ways.

- Portfolio of edits in the beauty / aesthetics / lifestyle / fashion niche specifically



--- NICE-TO-HAVE ---

- Experience editing beauty-education / aesthetic content

- Familiarity with trending TikTok audio sourcing

- AI tools workflow: ElevenLabs voiceover swaps, automatic captions (Submagic, Captions.ai)

- Speak any of French / Polish / Spanish / Italian (big bonus for QC'ing localized variants — NOT required)

- Some Photoshop / Illustrator for thumbnail and asset prep



--- COMPENSATION ---

$700/month for the first 30-day paid trial (3 master reels/week, deliver on time, hit our quality bar). Bumps to $900–1,100/month after a successful trial. Plus 13th-month and a performance bonus tied to retention metrics (average % watched on the reels you cut).



--- HOURS ---

Approx. 30–40h/week. Mostly async, but available at least 2 hours/day overlap with CET (so ~3 PM – 5 PM Manila time minimum).



--- TO APPLY, SEND ME ---

1. Your reel: a 60-second showreel of your best short-form edits, with timestamps indicating which clips are yours.

2. 3 links to specific reels you edited that performed well (we will check the metrics).

3. Your CapCut OR Premiere project file for ONE of those reels, so we can see your timeline and layer organization (you can scrub client names).

4. The word reels at the very top of your reply so we know you read this whole post.

5. Your salary expectation.



Applications missing any of these will be ignored.

title: Social Media Video Editor for Lifestyle Creator
description:
Full-Time Social Media Video Editor for Lifestyle / Family Creator



I’m looking for a talented, creative, and FAST full-time video editor to join my content team long-term.



I’m a U.S.-based lifestyle creator producing content around fatherhood, family, fitness, relationships, travel, adventure, products and everyday life.



I create content for Instagram, TikTok and brand partnerships.



I’m NOT looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and edits exactly what they’re given.



I’m looking for someone who can watch my footage and think:



“There are 5 different videos we can make from this.”



What You’ll Edit



You’ll work on:



* Instagram Reels

* TikToks

* Lifestyle/family content

* Talking-head videos

* Trend-based content

* UGC/product videos

* Sponsored brand campaigns

* Voiceover + B-roll videos

* Travel/adventure content

* Fitness content

* Short storytelling videos



Most videos will be 15–90 seconds.



What I’m Looking For



You should understand modern short-form content extremely well.



You need to understand:



* Strong hooks

* Retention

* Pacing

* Storytelling

* Captions/text

* Music selection

* Sound effects

* Pattern interrupts

* B-roll

* Comedy timing

* Emotional storytelling

* Current Instagram/TikTok editing styles



Most importantly, I want someone who thinks creatively without needing constant direction.



If I send you 20 minutes of footage, I want you looking for multiple pieces of content inside it.



Expected Monthly Output



The exact mix will change month to month, but a normal month could include:



* 20–30 organic social videos

* 10–15 trend/quick-turn videos

* UGC/product edits and hook variations

* 4–8 sponsored brand edits

* Alternate hooks/cuts when useful

* Repurposed content from existing footage



Some videos may take 15 minutes to edit. Others may take several hours.



We’re focused on quality + output, not hitting an arbitrary number.



Workflow



I film.



You turn the footage into content.



You’ll receive organized footage, voiceovers, brand briefs and ideas.



Over time, I want you to learn my style well enough that I need to give you LESS direction, not more.



You’ll also help maintain a content bank and identify unused footage that can become future posts.



Schedule



Full-time remote position.



You can work from the Philippines.



I don’t need you working U.S. hours all day, but I do need reliable communication and some overlap when necessary for brand deadlines.



Compensation



Starting compensation based on experience and editing ability.



Approximately $400-$500 USD/month, with opportunities for increases and bonuses based on performance.



I’m looking for someone long-term.



If you’re exceptional and help us dramatically increase our content output and quality, I want your compensation to grow with the role.



How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio

2. Your 3 BEST short-form videos

3. Your current editing software

4. Your expected monthly salary

5. Your availability

6. Your internet speed

7. Whether you’re currently working for other clients



And answer this question:



If I gave you 20 clips of family, fitness, travel, etc how many different pieces of short-form content do you think you could create from it? Give me 5 examples.



Start your application with the words:



LET ME COOK



Applications that don’t include this will not be considered.



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test using real footage.

title: ????? Architectural Design VA (Concept & 3D Visualisation for Modular Homes)
description:
Baird Built Ltd — Small Structure Design Competition

A design competition for OnlineJobs.ph — win NZD $400 + ongoing paid work

The opportunity



Baird Built Ltd (New Zealand) is looking for a talented concept designer. Submit one striking concept image, and you could win cash plus an ongoing paid design role.



Prize: NZD $400, PLUS the paid job of developing your design further, with likely ongoing paid work after that.



How it works:



Submit your concept.

We shortlist the best 4.

We post the 4 finalists on social media and the public votes — most votes wins.

What to design



A small transportable structure, under 30m², with a clear purpose — for example a sleepout, studio, guest suite, or glamping unit. Not a vague "small house": pick one specific purpose and design for it.



It should be:



Unusual and eye-catching — something that makes people stop and look twice

Purposeful — every unusual feature should have a reason, not just look cool

High-end — this is for a premium market, so use premium materials and finishes (timber shingle, slate, standing-seam metal roofing). Avoid materials like fibre-cement that read as budget in NZ.

Low maintenance — high-end doesn't mean high upkeep. Choosing durable, low-maintenance materials and details is a genuine selling point for a buyer, so factor it in alongside the look.



Here is an idea and our current top runner this will be included in the competition along with a floor plan. 



Quick NZ tips (please read — this trips up a lot of overseas designs)

New Zealand is in the Southern Hemisphere — the sun comes from the north, not the south. Put your main windows and living space facing north.

NZ is cold, not tropical — insulate well and use double glazing.

NZ had a "leaky homes" crisis — keep roof overhangs and cladding details simple and well-drained, complex high risk claddings can be a negative (our current image is high risk but we will let the public vote on that).

We can transport up to 4.5m wide and 3.6m high — bigger than a standard load, so feel free to think big. Multiple bolted-together modules are welcome too.

What to submit



Just one marketable concept image (render, sketch, or similar), a simple floor plan, plus a couple of sentences on the purpose, what makes it unusual, and why it's low-maintenance.

title: White-Label Google Ads Specialist for U.S. Local-Service Marketing Agency
description:
# White-Label Google Ads Specialist for U.S. Local-Service Marketing Agency



## Position Overview



We are a U.S.-based marketing company seeking an experienced Google Ads specialist to build and manage Search campaigns for local service businesses.



This is a completely white-label subcontractor position. You will work behind the scenes as part of our internal team. You will not communicate directly with clients or disclose your involvement.



We are starting with one account. Additional accounts may be assigned if the relationship is successful.



## Initial Campaign Responsibilities



* Research the local market and competitors

* Complete keyword research

* Build the Google Search campaign

* Organize campaigns and ad groups properly

* Write conversion-focused ads

* Configure geographic targeting

* Create an initial negative-keyword list

* Set up call and form conversion tracking

* Verify that conversions are recording correctly

* Review the landing page and recommend improvements

* Launch the campaign after internal approval

* Complete post-launch quality assurance



## Ongoing Account Management



* Review search terms and add negative keywords

* Monitor geographic traffic and exclude irrelevant locations

* Review bids, budgets, keywords, and match types

* Test and improve ads and assets

* Monitor call and form conversions

* Identify tracking or campaign problems

* Work to improve cost per qualified lead

* Maintain a record of important campaign changes

* Provide a short weekly internal update

* Prepare a simple monthly performance summary



## Required Experience



You must have direct experience managing Google Search campaigns for U.S. local-service businesses.



Relevant industries include:



* Contractors

* Home-service companies

* Environmental services

* Testing and inspection companies

* Restoration companies

* Other appointment- or estimate-based service businesses



You must be comfortable working with:



* Google Ads

* Google Tag Manager

* Google Analytics 4

* Call and form conversion tracking

* Keyword match types

* Negative-keyword management

* Search-term analysis

* Location targeting

* Lead-quality optimization

* Google Ads policy and account issues



Experience generating qualified leads for local service businesses is more important than e-commerce experience.



Strong spoken and written English is required. You must be able to clearly understand instructions, participate in video calls, explain campaign decisions, and communicate effectively with our internal team.



## White-Label Requirements



You must agree to the following:



* No direct communication with our clients

* No disclosure of your involvement

* No personal or contractor branding in campaigns, reports, or shared files

* No contacting or soliciting our clients

* No use of client work in your portfolio without written permission

* All reports and updates are delivered internally to our company

* Major campaign, strategy, and budget changes require our approval

* All client and campaign information must remain confidential

* All account access must be returned or removed when the engagement ends



## Compensation



This is a part-time freelance contractor position paid per active Google Ads account managed. It is not an hourly position or fixed employee salary.



* Ongoing management: $200–$300 USD per month, per account, depending on experience and responsibilities

* Initial campaign research, setup, tracking, testing, and launch are paid separately

* Additional accounts are compensated separately at an agreed per-account rate



The selected applicant will first complete a small paid campaign-planning test. This is not an unpaid trial.



Please include your requested one-time campaign setup fee and fixed monthly per-account management fee in your application.



## Time Requirement



* Up to five hours per week for the initial account

* Actual workload may vary depending on campaign activity

* Compensation is paid per active account managed, not hourly

* Initial campaign setup may require additional time and is compensated separately

* Working hours are flexible, but dependable communication and timely responses are required



## How to Apply



Begin your application with the words:



**SEARCH TERMS REVIEWED**



Applications that do not begin with those words will not be considered.



Then answer the following questions:



1. Describe two U.S. local-service Google Ads accounts you personally managed. Include the industry, approximate monthly ad spend, leads generated, and average cost per lead.



2. What percentage of your Google Ads experience is local-service lead generation compared with e-commerce?



3. How do you track phone calls and website form submissions accurately?



4. If a campaign generated clicks but no qualified leads, what are the first five things you would investigate?



5. How frequently do you review search terms and add negative keywords?



6. What information and access would you need from us before building the campaign?



7. What is your one-time campaign setup fee?



8. What is your fixed monthly management fee per account?



9. Are you comfortable working completely white-label with no direct client communication?



10. Include a three- to five-minute Loom video showing a Google Ads campaign you personally managed. You may hide the client’s name and sensitive information. Explain the campaign structure, conversion tracking, search-term management, and one optimization decision you made.



Generic applications, copied proposals, and applications without relevant local-service Google Ads experience will not be considered.



## Employment Details



* Part-time freelance contractor

* Up to five hours per week for the initial account

* Flexible working hours

* Paid per active account

* Long-term opportunity

* Potential for additional accounts based on performance

title: Real Estate Executive Assistant (Admin, Research & Prospecting Support)
description:
I am a real estate broker in Colorado, USA. I need a detail-obsessed assistant to own the administrative, research, and prospecting support side of my business so I can stay in front of clients.



This role is about accuracy and follow-through, not creativity. The single most important quality I am hiring for is this: when you tell me something is done, it is actually done.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Pull and format prospecting data into clean, ready-to-use call lists

- Build neighborhood and subdivision research briefs using a template I provide

- Compile market and comparable sales data into a set format

- Prepare listing presentation and pre-listing materials from existing templates

- Calendar management and appointment confirmation

- Inbox organization and flagging

- Data entry, list building, and online research

- Maintain trackers and update them daily without being asked

- General administrative support as my business grows



REQUIRED:

- 2+ years as a virtual assistant supporting a US-based business

- Excellent written English

- Strong Google Workspace skills, especially Sheets

- Genuine attention to detail. You will be tested on this.

- Reliable internet and power backup

- Available for a short daily check-in at the start of my business day

- Comfortable being shown exactly how I want something done, then doing it that way every time



NICE TO HAVE:

- US real estate experience

- Experience formatting or cleaning large data sets

- Familiarity with real estate prospecting platforms



HOW I WORK:

I give clear direction and I expect clear communication back. If something is going to be late, I want to hear it before the deadline, not after. Meet that standard and there is room for this to grow into a full-time role.



HOW I EXPECT YOU TO OPERATE:

One rule matters more than any other here: do not bring me a problem without bringing me at lease one proposed solution.



My measure for this role is simple. After I hand you something, I should not have to think about it again. If I am asking a second time, or waiting, or wondering where it stands, that is the problem I am hiring you to eliminate.



In practice that looks like:

- You spot bad data in a list and flag it with a fix, rather than delivering it and letting me find out

- You have done the same task ten times, so you build a checklist and stop needing instructions for it

- Something will be late, and I hear it from you before the deadline, not after

- You are unsure what I want, so you ask before you spend three hours, not after

- You notice something that needs doing and you do it, without being assigned



If you would rather be handed a task list every morning and work only from it, this is not the right role for you.



TIME TRACKING:

For your first 90 days, you will use TimeProof through OnlineJobs.ph. I want to be upfront about why: this is a new role and I do not yet have a good sense of how long each task actually takes. The tracking data is how I build realistic workloads and deadlines instead of guessing and setting you up to fail.



It is not there to police you. I judge this role on results, not on hours logged. After 90 days, once we both know what the work actually takes, we can revisit whether it stays on.



HOW TO APPLY:

Read this carefully. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



1. Begin your message with the word COMPASS so I know you read the full post.

2. Tell me about a specific time you caught a mistake that someone else missed. Be specific about what it was and how you found it.

3. List every research, spreadsheet, and project management tool you have actually used yourself.

4. Tell me how many other clients you currently work for, and roughly how many hours per week each one takes.

5. Tell me your internet speed and whether you have a backup power source.

6. Confirm you can work the schedule listed above.

7. Confirm you are comfortable using TimeProof during your first 90 days.

8. Answer this scenario in a few sentences. I ask you to build me a call list from a data export by tomorrow morning. Halfway through, you realize roughly 15% of the records have obviously wrong phone numbers, and I am unreachable in appointments. What do you actually do?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short PAID data accuracy test before any offer is made.

PRIMARY KPI

**NEW QUALITY REFERRING DOMAINS ACQUIRED**



We care much more about obtaining links from **new, legitimate referring domains** than generating hundreds of links from the same websites.



DOMAIN AUTHORITY TARGETS

**Tier 1**

* DR 70+



**Tier 2**

LINK QUALITY MATTERS

* Not obviously created exclusively for selling links

* Not overloaded with spam

* Not part of an obvious PBN

* Not primarily casino/adult/pharmaceutical/spam content

We will prioritize **quality + relevance + authority**, not just DR.



DAILY WORK MAY INCLUDE

* Follow up on previous outreach

* Negotiate placements

* Submit business profiles

* Monitor acquired links

* Report daily KPI performance



SEO TOOLS

* Google Sheets

* Screaming Frog

* Moz

* Majestic

* Be excellent at Google research

* Be comfortable with
 outreach

* Be persistent with follow-up

THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

PERFORMANCE WILL BE TRACKED

* Links secured

* DR of acquired domains

Top performers who consistently acquire authoritative referring domains will receive preference for **long-term employment, additional responsibility, and performance incentives.**



OUR GOAL

HOW TO APPLY

**“DR70”**

title: VIDEO EDITOR (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES | PART-TIME)
description:
This Is NOT Just Another Editing Job



We are building something bigger than content. We are building a brand that dominates attention, builds trust instantly, and converts viewers into customers and clients across roofing, construction, and real estate.



If you are a high-level video editor who understands storytelling, pacing, and visual impact—and who knows how to leverage AI video tools to produce more, faster, without losing quality—keep reading.



Who We Are



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based company operating across roofing and construction, real estate and property development, and media and community-based platforms. We move fast. We execute. And we expect excellence.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented Video Editor (AI-Assisted) based in the Philippines who can create high-impact short-form and long-form content, generate and integrate AI-produced video, avatars, and B-roll into real client work, and turn raw footage into compelling, conversion-driven content. This is a part-time remote role, but performance-based growth opportunities are very real.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



First, you must be advanced in at least one major editing platform—CapCut at a high level, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro. If you are not highly proficient in editing software, this role is not for you.



Second, and this is a major factor for us, you must have hands-on, proven experience generating video and visual assets with AI tools. We are talking about Veo 3 for cinematic text-to-video, Seedance for AI video generation, HeyGen for avatars and talking heads, Higgsfield for motion control and ad creative, Nano Banana for image generation and editing, and comparable platforms like Runway, Kling, Sora, ElevenLabs, or Midjourney. We actively use these tools in production every day. If you have never generated AI video and worked it into a real edit, this role is not for you. Please include AI-generated samples in your portfolio and tell us which tool produced which shot.



Your Responsibilities



On the editing side, you will cut short-form content for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok, along with long-form pieces for YouTube, brand videos, and interviews. That includes clean transitions, captions and subtitles, motion graphics, and sound design.



On the AI side, you will write effective prompts that produce usable footage rather than impressive tests. You will generate AI B-roll, product and property visuals, and scene fillers where live footage does not exist. You will build AI avatar and voiceover content for ads, explainers, and localized versions. Most importantly, you will blend AI-generated footage seamlessly with real footage so it reads as intentional, not artificial—upscaling, reframing, and cleaning up output until it is genuinely usable. Over time, you will help us track what works and build repeatable AI workflows.



You will also handle supporting design work: thumbnails, social visuals, and branding elements, all consistent with our brand style.



What Makes You a Strong Candidate



You understand storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention. You can make content feel modern, clean, and premium. You know the difference between AI footage that sells and AI footage that looks fake. You have an eye for detail and composition, you are fast and responsive and reliable, and you can follow direction while still bringing your own creative ideas. You also stay current as new tools launch, because this space changes monthly.



It is a bonus if you have edited construction, real estate, or business content before, if you understand short-form viral trends, if you know how to edit for engagement and conversions, or if you have built and documented an AI content workflow.



Work Style Expectations



This is a fast-paced environment. Clear communication is required. Deadlines matter, and quality matters more. We are not looking for average—we are looking for someone who takes pride in producing top-tier work consistently, and who sees AI as a way to do more of it.



How to Apply



Send us your portfolio or reel, at least two examples of AI-generated video you personally produced along with the tools used, and a short note on which AI tools you reach for most and why.

title: Virtual Receptionist - Real Estate & Mortgage Brokerage
description:
We are looking for a friendly, professional, energetic, and extremely dependable **Virtual Receptionist VA** to serve as the first point of contact for our real estate and mortgage clients.



Your primary responsibility is simple:



**Make sure every incoming lead and client receives a fast, professional response and gets connected to the correct person or next step.**



You will handle incoming calls, missed-call follow-up, appointment scheduling, basic lead qualification, CRM updates, and client communication.



YOUR ROLE

You may speak with:



* Home buyers

* Home sellers

* Mortgage borrowers

* Homeowners interested in refinancing

* Real estate investors

* Rental clients

* Realtors

* Lenders

* Title companies

* Vendors

* Existing clients

* Past clients

* Referral partners



You must be comfortable speaking with people throughout the day.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

**Incoming Calls**



* Answer incoming business calls

* Professionally greet callers

* Determine why they are calling

* Collect necessary information

* Route calls appropriately

* Take detailed messages

* Schedule appointments

* Update CRM records immediately



**Missed Calls**



* Return missed calls quickly

* Send follow-up text messages when appropriate

* Identify whether the caller is a new lead or existing client

* Document the outcome

* Create appropriate follow-up tasks



**Lead Qualification**



For real estate leads, you may ask questions such as:



* Are you looking to buy, sell, or rent?

* What area are you interested in?

* What is your price range?

* When are you looking to move?

* Are you already working with an agent?

* Do you need financing?



For mortgage leads:



* Are you purchasing or refinancing?

* What type of property?

* Approximate purchase price?

* Approximate down payment?

* Have you already completed a loan application?

* When are you hoping to close?



You are NOT expected to provide mortgage advice or quote loan terms unless specifically authorized.



Your job is to **collect information and move the prospect to the correct next step.**



APPOINTMENT SETTING

You will help schedule:



* Buyer consultations

* Seller consultations

* Listing appointments

* Property showings

* Mortgage consultations

* Pre-approval appointments

* Client follow-up calls

You will confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows.

* Apply tags

* Update lead stages

* Create follow-up tasks

* Record appointment dates

* Identify urgent leads

CLIENT FOLLOW-UP

You may also:



* Call new internet leads

* Confirm that clients received
s/documents

* Remind clients about appointments

* Contact older leads

* Reconnect with past clients

* Follow up with referral partners

* Request reviews after successful transactions



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You are:



* Friendly

* Energetic

* Professional

* Patient

* Confident on the phone

* Excellent at spoken English

* Easy to understand

* Organized

* Reliable

* Comfortable following scripts

* Comfortable handling objections

* Comfortable speaking with strangers

* Able to multitask

* Fast at entering notes while talking

* Comfortable using CRMs and web-based software



ENGLISH REQUIREMENTS

Because you will regularly speak with U.S.-based clients, **excellent spoken English is extremely important.**



Your accent does NOT need to be American.



However, callers must be able to understand you clearly and comfortably.



EXPERIENCE PREFERRED

Experience in any of these industries is helpful:



* Real Estate

* Mortgage

* Call Center

* Customer Service

* Appointment Setting

* Inside Sales

* Reception

* Lead Qualification

Real estate or mortgage experience is preferred but not mandatory for an exceptional communicator.



TECHNOLOGY

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

VERY IMPORTANT

We are NOT looking for someone who simply answers the phone and says:



“I'll leave a message.”

Incoming Lead
