title: Flower Buyer / Remote Position
description:
We are looking for a very tech savvy person who loves spreadsheets, is excited about AI, and has an interest in FLOWERS with willingness to learn.



That last part is the piece most people get backwards. You do not need to walk in knowing the difference between a garden rose and a regular rose. We can teach that. What we cannot teach in a week is somebody who lights up at a clean formula, who notices when a number is wrong, and who is already using AI tools daily because they find them interesting.



If you love numbers, love organizing information, excel at multitasking without getting overwhelmed receiving information from multiple pipelines and think working with AI every day is fun, and flowers sound like something you would enjoy learning, this is a good fit.



Main priorities of the position: Managing recipe build, bulk buys, budgets, product ordering and vendor communication



This is a technology job that happens to be about flowers.



Tools you will use every day

Google Sheets. Heavily. This is where you will live.

ClickUp. Every task, every event, every note.

. A lot of it, with vendors and with our team.

Claude and ChatGPT. Daily, not occasionally.

Our internal floral program for recipes and bulk buys. We will teach you this one.





Hours and location

This is a remote position. What is not flexible is the clock: you need to be working during Pacific Time business hours, because you will be coordinating with our Los Angeles studio in real time throughout the day (Monday - Friday from 9am-5pm or 6am-2pm depending on the day)



Compensation and exact hours to be confirmed.



Who we are looking for - MUST HAVE



Genuinely strong experience with Google Sheets. Formulas, lookups, data validation, conditional formatting, and the discipline to make a sheet look finished rather than functional.

Math in terms of pricing/cost and budgeting. You should like numbers, not tolerate them.

Already using AI tools and interested in where they are going. We will hand you an AI agent and expect you to run it well, notice when it is wrong, and help make it better.

Excellent written communication. This job is
, recipes, ClickUp comments, and clear notes. If you are remote, your writing is how we know what is happening.

Very organized, with real time management. We are an event related business, pop ups and tight deadlines are a real thing. You need to be able to self-manage your time and efficiency so that when the unexpected happens, you are still in control and can execute successfully.

Detail obsessive. A wrong cell in a spreadsheet becomes the wrong flowers in a hotel lobby.

Open to extending your knowledge of flowers. Curious about varieties, seasons, and what makes product good quality.



Would be nice to have but not required: 

Any floral, event, catering or hospitality background

Experience with ClickUp

Scripting ability, Google Apps Script or similar

Experience buying, purchasing or inventory work in any industry



Not required



Floral Design skill. This seat buys, it does not design.

Existing flower expertise. Interest counts more than experience here.





What success looks like

First 30 days. You know the sheet and the rhythm. You are producing the buying list alongside someone else and it is coming out clean.



By 60 days. You own the list end to end for all product receiving days, plus our weekly hotel and lobby accounts. Invoice coding is fully yours.



By 90 days. You have automated at least two manual steps out of the weekly build, and you are the person who knows the numbers better than anyone else here.







What you can expect from us

We are a luxury floral studio in Los Angeles that has been around since 1999. We do the Beverly Hills Hotel, Hotel Bel-Air, the Four Seasons Beverly Wilshire, the Waldorf Astoria, weddings, and large events. Our work is beautiful and the pace is real. We execute high quality floral designs and need someone that can stay on top of the ordering and budgeting in real time.   



You can be trained on the flower side. You will be handed AI tools and encouraged to push on them. You will report directly to the owner and operations manager, which means when you find a better way to do something, there is nobody in between you and the decision.



if this sounds like something you would love - respond back with the word HYDRANGEA at the top of your reply so we know you read all the way through this!

Full-Time Social Media Video Editor for Lifestyle / Family Creator



I’m looking for a talented, creative, and FAST full-time video editor to join my content team long-term.



I’m a U.S.-based lifestyle creator producing content around fatherhood, family, fitness, relationships, travel, adventure, products and everyday life.

I’m NOT looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and edits exactly what they’re given.



I’m looking for someone who can watch my footage and think:



“There are 5 different videos we can make from this.”



What You’ll Edit



You’ll work on:



* Instagram Reels

* TikToks

* Lifestyle/family content

* Talking-head videos

* Trend-based content

* UGC/product videos

* Sponsored brand campaigns

* Voiceover + B-roll videos

* Travel/adventure content

* Fitness content

* Short storytelling videos



Most videos will be 15–90 seconds.



What I’m Looking For



You should understand modern short-form content extremely well.



You need to understand:



* Strong hooks

* Retention

* Pacing

* Storytelling

* Captions/text

* Music selection

* Sound effects

* Pattern interrupts

* B-roll

* Comedy timing

* Emotional storytelling

* Current Instagram/TikTok editing styles



Most importantly, I want someone who thinks creatively without needing constant direction.



If I send you 20 minutes of footage, I want you looking for multiple pieces of content inside it.



Expected Monthly Output



The exact mix will change month to month, but a normal month could include:



* 20–30 organic social videos

* 10–15 trend/quick-turn videos

* UGC/product edits and hook variations

* 4–8 sponsored brand edits

* Alternate hooks/cuts when useful

* Repurposed content from existing footage



Some videos may take 15 minutes to edit. Others may take several hours.



We’re focused on quality + output, not hitting an arbitrary number.



Workflow



I film.



You turn the footage into content.



You’ll receive organized footage, voiceovers, brand briefs and ideas.



Over time, I want you to learn my style well enough that I need to give you LESS direction, not more.



You’ll also help maintain a content bank and identify unused footage that can become future posts.



Schedule



Full-time remote position.



You can work from the Philippines.



I don’t need you working U.S. hours all day, but I do need reliable communication and some overlap when necessary for brand deadlines.



Compensation



Starting compensation based on experience and editing ability.



Approximately $700–$1,000 USD/month, with opportunities for increases and bonuses based on performance.



I’m looking for someone long-term.



If you’re exceptional and help us dramatically increase our content output and quality, I want your compensation to grow with the role.



How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio

2. Your 3 BEST short-form videos

3. Your current editing software

4. Your expected monthly salary

5. Your availability

6. Your internet speed

7. Whether you’re currently working for other clients



And answer this question:



If I gave you 20 minutes of footage from a family beach day, how many different pieces of short-form content do you think you could create from it? Give me 5 examples.



Start your application with the words:



LET ME COOK



Applications that don’t include this will not be considered.



Final candidates will complete a paid editing test using real footage.

description:
# Executive Operations Coordinator (Remote | Full-Time)



## About the Role



We're looking for a highly organized, reliable, and proactive Operations Coordinator to work directly with the founder of a fast-growing international online business.



This is not a typical virtual assistant position. You'll become the founder's right hand, helping manage daily operations, coordinate with external partners, keep projects organized, and ensure everything runs efficiently behind the scenes.



We're looking for someone who enjoys building systems, solving problems, and taking ownership of their work. If you're ambitious and looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow into a leadership position, we'd love to hear from you.



Our goal is to promote the right person into an Operations Manager role within the next 6–12 months.



---



## What You'll Do



### Daily Operations



* Manage recurring operational tasks and ensure everything is completed on schedule.

* Keep projects organized and follow up on pending tasks.

* Assist the founder with day-to-day operational priorities.

* Coordinate multiple ongoing projects simultaneously.



### Partner Communication



* Communicate professionally with external business partners through
 and
.

* Request updates and follow up on outstanding items.

* Keep communication organized and well documented.

* Build positive professional relationships with partners.



### Content & Platform Management



* Schedule and publish content according to internal schedules.

* Execute recurring campaigns and operational tasks.

* Ensure all publishing and operational processes are completed accurately.

* Perform quality checks and report any issues.



### Reporting & Organization



* Update Google Sheets and internal tracking systems.

* Maintain accurate records and databases.

* Prepare daily and weekly operational summaries.

* Organize files, documentation, and project information.



### Process Improvement



* Help document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.

* Suggest better workflows and organizational systems.

* Assist with implementing new tools and processes.



### Founder Support



* Help prioritize tasks and projects.

* Conduct research when needed.

* Handle operational and administrative requests.

* Assist with new business initiatives and special projects.



---



## Who We're Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who:



* Is extremely organized.

* Has exceptional attention to detail.

* Has excellent written English.

* Learns new software quickly.

* Is proactive and enjoys solving problems.

* Takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

* Can manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed.

* Is dependable, responsible, and trustworthy.

* Enjoys creating structure and improving systems.

* Wants to build a long-term career in operations.



---



## Requirements



### Required



* Excellent written English.

* Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, Administrative Assistant, or a similar role.

* Strong Google Sheets skills.

* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve productivity.

* Experience using project management software (Airtable, ClickUp, Notion, Asana, 
, or similar).

* Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

* Quiet home working environment.



### Nice to Have



* Experience improving internal processes.

* Experience documenting SOPs.

* Experience working with remote teams.

* Experience in fast-paced online businesses.



---



## Working Hours



* Full-Time (40 hours per week)

* Monday to Friday

* **9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Prague, Czech Republic Time)**



Applicants must be available to work during these hours.



---



## Compensation



* Starting salary: **$4 USD per hour**

* Full-time position

* Salary reviews based on performance and increased responsibilities.

* Opportunity to grow into an Operations Manager role with significantly greater responsibility.



---



## Why Join Us?



* Work directly with the founder of a rapidly growing international business.

* Gain valuable operations and business management experience.

* Be involved in improving systems and scaling a company.

* Work in a role where your ideas and initiative are valued.

* Clear opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility.



---



## How to Apply



If you're interested in joining our team, please complete our application form using the link below:

The application takes approximately **10–15 minutes** to complete.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of our hiring process.

title: Sales Specialist – Rosegate Property Management (Full-Time)
description:
Join a Growing Property Management Company & Build Your Sales Career



Rosegate Property Management is a growing property management company serving property owners and real estate investors across Ontario.



We are looking for a confident, motivated, and sales-driven Sales Specialist to join our team and focus on promoting our Tenant Placement Service.



If you enjoy talking to people, are comfortable making outbound calls, can handle objections, and are motivated by earning commission, we want to hear from you.



Previous real estate experience is not required. What matters most is your attitude, communication skills, work ethic, and willingness to learn.



What You'll Be Doing

Generate and work with leads using company-provided platforms and tools.

Make outbound calls to property owners and real estate investors.

Introduce Rosegate's Tenant Placement Service and explain its value.

Build rapport and establish trust with potential clients.

Ask the right questions to understand the owner's needs and situation.

Handle objections confidently and professionally.

Qualify prospects and schedule property assessments.

Follow up consistently with leads and prospects.

Help move qualified prospects through the sales process toward signed agreements.

Maintain accurate notes and activity in our CRM.

Consistently work toward individual and team sales targets.

We're Looking for Someone Who Is:

Confident and persuasive when speaking on the phone.

Comfortable with outbound calling and speaking with new people.

A strong English communicator with a professional phone presence.

Sales-minded and motivated by results.

Comfortable handling rejection and objections without giving up.

Persistent and consistent with follow-ups.

Organized and able to manage multiple leads.

Self-motivated and capable of working independently.

Competitive in a positive way and motivated to hit targets.

Coachable and willing to follow proven sales systems.

Reliable, hardworking, and committed to improving every day.

You Don't Need to Be an Expert — You Need the Right Mindset.



We can teach you our industry, service, CRM, scripts, and sales process.



What we cannot teach is drive, confidence, work ethic, and the willingness to pick up the phone and have conversations.



If you are the type of person who enjoys sales, likes talking to people, and wants to improve your income through performance, this could be a great opportunity for you.



Training & Support



No previous real estate experience is required.



We provide comprehensive training covering:



Our Tenant Placement Service

CRM systems and lead management

Our sales process and proven scripts

Objection handling and rebuttals

Appointment-setting techniques

Follow-up strategies

Sales communication and closing techniques

Ongoing coaching and performance feedback



You will have the tools and support you need to succeed.



Compensation



Base Salary: CAD $650 per month + Commission



You will also earn commission on every signed Tenant Placement Agreement you generate.



Successful Sales Specialists can earn approximately CAD $1,600+ per month through a combination of base salary and commissions.



There is no cap on commission earnings.



The more qualified conversations you create, the more appointments you book, and the more agreements you help close, the more you can earn.



Why Join Rosegate?

1. Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

2. Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding company

3.  Full sales training provided

4. Proven scripts and sales systems

5. Ongoing coaching and support

6. Work remotely

7. Opportunity to build a long-term career in sales and real estate



How to Apply

Your resume.

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Expert
description:
About ERPS Group



ERPS Group is a fast-growing accounting, tax, and business advisory firm dedicated to helping business owners build stronger, more profitable companies. We provide accounting, tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll, CFO advisory, and business consulting services to clients across multiple industries.

Our mission is to deliver exceptional client service while helping entrepreneurs make informed financial decisions and achieve long-term success. We believe in professionalism, accountability, continuous improvement, and teamwork. Every member of our team plays an important role in creating an outstanding client experience.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Full-Charge Bookkeeper who can independently manage the day-to-day bookkeeping operations of a U.S.-based company.

The ideal candidate is highly experienced with QuickBooks Online/Desktop (QBO, QBD) and understands bookkeeping from end to end — including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, invoicing, reconciliations, financial reporting, and month-end closing.

This is not a data-entry position. We need someone who understands why transactions are recorded a certain way, can identify discrepancies, and can maintain accurate and organized financial records with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



QuickBooks & Bookkeeping

 - Manage the company’s bookkeeping activities in QuickBooks.

 - Record and categorize daily financial transactions accurately.

 - Maintain the chart of accounts and ensure transactions are properly classified.

 - Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

 - Review accounts for discrepancies, duplicates, missing transactions, and unusual activity.

 - Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.



Accounts Payable

 - Manage vendor bills and accounts payable.

 - Enter, categorize, and track bills in QuickBooks.

 - Monitor outstanding payables and payment due dates.

 - Verify invoices and supporting documentation.

 - Maintain accurate vendor records.

 - Assist with payment processing and AP reporting.



Accounts Receivable & Invoicing

 - Create and send customer invoices.

 - Track outstanding invoices and accounts receivable.

 - Apply customer payments accurately.

 - Follow up on overdue invoices when required.

 - Reconcile customer accounts and resolve discrepancies.

 - Maintain accurate customer records.



Month-End & Financial Reporting

 - Complete monthly bank, credit card, AP, and AR reconciliations.

 - Assist with month-end closing procedures.

 - Prepare and maintain monthly financial statements, including:

 - Profit & Loss

 - Balance Sheet

 - Accounts Receivable Aging

 - Accounts Payable Aging

 - Cash flow reports

 - Identify unusual fluctuations and communicate potential issues to management.

 - Provide clean and accurate financial information for management and tax/accounting purposes.



Requirements



3+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, preferably supporting U.S.-based businesses.

Advanced knowledge of QuickBooks Online/Desktop.

Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and accounting principles.

Strong experience with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

Proven experience with invoicing and payment tracking.

Strong bank and credit card reconciliation experience.

Experience with month-end closing and financial reporting.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to identify errors and discrepancies rather than simply entering data.

Excellent English written communication skills.

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office setup.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with U.S. companies and U.S. accounting practices.

Experience with service-based businesses.

Experience working with multiple entities or businesses.

Familiarity with payroll transactions and payroll reconciliations.

Familiarity with sales tax accounting.

Experience working alongside CPAs, tax preparers, or CFOs.

QuickBooks Online certification is a plus.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:

Detail-oriented — small discrepancies do not get overlooked.

Proactive — you identify problems before they become bigger problems.

Accountable — you take ownership of your work and deadlines.

Organized — financial records are clean, structured, and easy to understand.

Analytical — you understand the numbers rather than simply entering transactions.

Independent — you can manage your responsibilities without constant supervision.

Confidential and trustworthy — you will be working with sensitive financial information.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role means:

Books are accurate and up to date.

Bank and credit card accounts are reconciled consistently.

AP and AR are properly maintained.

Invoices are issued accurately and on time.

Outstanding receivables are actively monitored.

Month-end closing is completed on schedule.

Financial reports are accurate and reliable.

Errors and discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly.

Management can rely on the bookkeeping records to make business decisions.



How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a 1-min video explaining why you’re the perfect fit for this role. We're looking for a driven leader ready to help us 10X our impact while creating transformational results for our clients and team.



IMPORTANT: Please do not apply if you only have basic QuickBooks or data-entry experience. We are specifically looking for a strong, hands-on full-charge bookkeeper who can own the bookkeeping function.

title: Social Media Manager & Video Editor (Real Estate, CapCut + Sprout Social)
description:
I am a real estate broker in Colorado, USA, running a personal brand built on neighborhood and lifestyle content. I publish short-form vertical reels, mid-form YouTube videos, a monthly
 newsletter, and a local events guide.



I am looking for one person to own social media end to end. Not just posting. Owning it. You will run the content calendar, edit the video, publish across platforms through Sprout Social, and tell me what is working and what to do more of.



Important: this is a hands-on production role. You will spend most of your week inside an editing timeline. I am not looking for someone who directs a team or subcontracts the editing. If you do not personally edit video every day, please do not apply.



Salary will be $700 - $900 USD/mo based on experience and portfolio



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Social media ownership:

- Own and run the content calendar across Instagram,
, YouTube, and TikTok

- Manage scheduling and publishing through Sprout Social

- Write captions in my established brand voice (I will give you a voice guide)

- Monitor comments and engagement, flag anything needing my personal reply

- Report monthly on what performed and recommend what we do more of



Video production:

- Edit vertical short-form video from raw footage I send you

- Add styled text overlays, captions, b-roll, and music to match my brand look

- Cut long-form YouTube footage into multiple short clips

- Manage YouTube uploads, titles, descriptions, tags, and thumbnails



Supporting work:

- Build graphics and templates in Canva using my existing brand kit

- Build and send monthly newsletters in MailerLite from copy I provide



REQUIRED:

- 2+ years running social media for a business or personal brand, including doing the editing yourself

- Strong working knowledge of CapCut Pro. This is where my footage lives.

- Experience with a social scheduling platform. Sprout Social preferred, but Hootsuite, Later, or Buffer experience transfers.

- Canva proficiency

- Clean written English. You will write captions in my voice, and voice matters more to me than almost anything else in this role.

- A computer and internet connection that handle large video files without hours of transfer time

- Reliable power backup

- Available for a short daily check-in at the start of my business day



NICE TO HAVE:

- Real estate, hospitality, or travel content experience

- MailerLite or similar
 platform experience

- TubeBuddy or YouTube channel growth experience

- Adobe Premiere or DaVinci Resolve in addition to CapCut

- Meta 
 and Instagram) ads experience, particularly under Meta's Special Ad Category rules for housing. Paid ads are not part of this role today, but may be added later for the right person.



HOW I WORK:

I give clear direction and I expect clear communication back. If something is going to be late, I want to hear it before the deadline, not after. I will hand you real ownership of this channel. Meet that standard and this is a stable, long-term role with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY:



Read this carefully. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



1. Begin your message with the word SUNRISE so I know you read the full post.

2. Send 3 links to vertical short-form videos that YOU personally edited. Not your agency's showreel. Not a downloaded template. For each one, tell me exactly what you did.

3. Tell me which software you used for each of the 3.

4. Answer honestly: do you personally do all your own editing, or do you work with a team or subcontractors? Either answer is fine. I only need to know.

5. Tell me which social scheduling platforms you have used and roughly how many accounts you managed at once.

6. In 2 or 3 sentences, in your own words: what makes a real estate neighborhood video worth watching for someone who is not shopping for a house?

7. Tell me how many other clients you currently work for, and roughly how many hours per week each one takes.

8. Confirm you can work the schedule listed above.

9. Optional: if you have run Meta ads for a real estate or other housing client, tell me what you ran and what results you got. Not required, and it will not count against you if you have not.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small PAID trial edit before any offer is made.

title: Medical Billing Specialist
description:
Medical Billing Specialist

Full-Time | Remote | Healthcare



Please submit an up-to-date resume. Inquiries will not be considered without a resume.



Seeking an experienced Medical Billing Specialist to support U.S.-based healthcare practices on a full-time remote basis. This is a billing-first role built for professionals who know the full revenue cycle, not just one piece of it, and who take ownership of the financial health of the practices they support.



In this role, you will manage the complete billing cycle: claim submission, payment posting, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, and reporting. You will work directly with practice leadership and administrative teams to ensure claims are clean, payments are collected, and outstanding balances are resolved in a timely manner. You may also provide light support to front desk and administrative functions as a secondary responsibility.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Claims Submission & Billing Operations

- Process and submit insurance claims accurately and in a timely manner via EMR and clearinghouse systems

- Manage the full billing cycle including claim creation, submission, tracking, and follow-up

- Handle primary and secondary insurance claims, including out-of-network and manual tracking requirements

- Ensure all claims are submitted with correct coding, documentation, and payer-specific requirements

- Resolve billing discrepancies by identifying root causes, correcting errors, and rebilling claims as needed

- Ensure compliance with billing and coding regulations and maintain clean documentation for audit readiness



Accounts Receivable & Payment Management

- Monitor and reconcile the accounts receivable ledger and maintain accurate, up-to-date A/R records

- Follow up on outstanding balances, unpaid claims, and overdue accounts to support healthy cash flow

- Post insurance and patient payments to accounts accurately and ensure proper allocation

- Post zero-balance EOBs and process patient refunds as required

- Generate and distribute monthly statements to patients and clients

- Support collections workflows and escalate unresolved balances as appropriate

- Generate billing and A/R reports for practice leadership on a regular basis



Denials Management & Appeals

- Review denied claims promptly, research denial reasons, and determine the appropriate course of action

- Prepare and submit appeals with supporting documentation to secure proper reimbursement

- Track denial trends and communicate findings to leadership to support process improvements

- Follow up on appealed claims and rework as needed until resolution

- Identify and help prevent future denials through accurate claim preparation and payer knowledge



Patient Billing Communication

- Make outbound calls to patients or guarantors to follow up on outstanding balances, declined payments, or billing questions

- Communicate billing details, payment options, and insurance responsibilities clearly and professionally

- Respond to patient inquiries related to statements, claims, and account balances via phone and

- Document all billing-related communications and update patient records accordingly



Administrative & Reporting Support

- Maintain accurate electronic patient records and billing documentation within the EMR

- Track referrals, plans of care, and authorization-related billing requirements as needed

- Generate key performance and billing reports for management review

- Support insurance verification and benefits checks as needed to ensure billing accuracy

- Assist with administrative workflows, front desk backup duties, or special projects as assigned by the client

- Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

- 2+ years of hands-on medical billing experience: this is not an entry-level role

- Proven experience managing the full revenue cycle: claim submission, payment posting, A/R follow-up, and denials

- Strong working knowledge of insurance billing processes, payer requirements, and reimbursement rules

- Experience with denials management, including researching, correcting, appealing, and tracking claims to resolution

- Solid understanding of EOB interpretation, payment reconciliation, and accounts receivable principles

- Ability to handle both primary and secondary insurance claims, including manual follow-up processes

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: clear phone communication with patients and payers is essential

- Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through across all billing activities

- Ability to work independently, self-direct daily tasks, and meet targets without close supervision

- Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant remote work



Preferred

- Experience in an outpatient healthcare setting: physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or similar specialties

- Familiarity with common healthcare EMR and billing platforms (e.g., Prompt, WebPT, Raintree, or similar)

- Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, workers' compensation, and out-of-network billing

- Background working with multi-provider or high-volume clinic environments

- Comfort with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office (Word/Excel), and cloud-based communication tools



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Ownership: you treat the practice's A/R like your own and don't let claims sit unresolved

- Expertise: you can read an EOB, identify why a claim was denied, and know exactly what to do next

- Initiative: when something is off, you flag it, fix it, and help prevent it from happening again

- Reliability: your client team counts on your daily output; you show up, you deliver, and you communicate clearly

- Professionalism: you handle patient billing calls with patience, empathy, and accuracy



BENEFITS

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience

- Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth

- Work within a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive team environment

- Stable, full-time remote employment with U.S.-based healthcare clients

- Make a meaningful impact by helping practices serve their patients and communities

title: U.S. Insurance Agency Operations and Agent Support Contractors
description:
US Supplemental Health Insurance Operations Specialist | Agent Licensing, NSF and Policyholder Service



Shore Legacy Insurance is a growing Florida based insurance agency selling supplemental health insurance in 26 states.



We are looking for an experienced insurance operations professional in the Philippines who already understands US insurance.



This is NOT an entry level VA position. This is NOT a sales or appointment setting position.



Please apply only if you have real experience working in US insurance operations and have handled agent licensing, NSF or returned premium issues, and customer or policyholder service.



ABOUT OUR BUSINESS



We currently focus primarily on supplemental health insurance.



We work with carriers including:



ManhattanLife



American Home Life, AHL



United National Life, UNL



Guarantee Trust Life, GTL



Our products include hospital indemnity, home health care insurance, and other supplemental health products.



We are also looking at expanding into Medicare and possibly ACA. Experience in those areas is a plus, but it is not required.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO HANDLE



Agent Licensing



Help our insurance agents obtain licenses in multiple US states.



Track applications, renewals, outstanding requirements, and licensing problems.



Work with NIPR, Sircon, state insurance departments, and other licensing systems when applicable.



Follow up until licensing issues are actually resolved.



Assist with carrier contracting and appointments when needed.



NSF AND RETURNED PREMIUM FOLLOW UP



This is an important part of the position.



You will help us manage customers whose insurance premium payments do not go through.



This can include NSF payments, returned ACH payments, failed bank drafts, and other unsuccessful premium payments.



You will contact customers when appropriate, work with insurance carriers, determine what needs to be corrected, and follow the issue until it is resolved.



You may also help with policy reinstatements or other problems caused by failed premium payments.



We need someone who understands that an NSF should not simply be noted in a CRM and forgotten. It needs follow up.



POLICYHOLDER AND CARRIER SERVICE



Help existing customers with policy questions and service issues.



Contact insurance carriers to resolve problems.



Follow up on cancellations, reinstatements, policy changes, claims questions, and other service matters.



Document what happened and make sure the issue reaches a conclusion.



EXPERIENCE WITH THESE AREAS IS A BIG PLUS



Commission statements



Agent commission reconciliation



Chargebacks



Agent commission payments or payroll



Carrier commission disputes



Carrier contracting and appointments



Tracking agent production



Medicare operations



ACA operations



SunFire or similar insurance platforms



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You should already have experience working with a US insurance agency, IMO, FMO, insurance carrier, or similar US insurance organization.



You should have hands on experience with insurance agent licensing.



You should understand NSF, returned premiums, failed drafts, or insurance payment recovery.



You should have experience dealing directly with insurance carriers and policyholders.



You should be organized and persistent.



You should be comfortable picking up the phone and solving a problem.



You should be able to manage multiple open issues without losing track of them.



Most importantly, we want someone who follows through.



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please do not apply if your experience is primarily:



General virtual assistance



Appointment setting



Lead generation



Insurance sales only



Generic BPO customer service



Healthcare customer service without US insurance operations experience



We are purposely looking for someone with actual US insurance operations experience.



WHY THIS COULD BE A GOOD OPPORTUNITY



Shore Legacy Insurance is growing.



We want someone who can take responsibility for an important part of our insurance operations and become someone we can rely on.



For the right person, there should be plenty to learn and additional areas to take responsibility for as the agency grows.



This is a long term remote independent contractor opportunity for someone located in the Philippines.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer every question below. Applications that do not answer these questions will not be reviewed.

I own a **13-unit furnished short-term rental property in Tacoma, Washington** and am looking for an experienced Short-Term Rental Operations Manager to help me transition from traditional property management to a streamlined, technology-driven operation.



**This is NOT an entry-level VA position.**

, Turno, Hospitable Direct Booking and mid-term rental experience are major advantages.**

Much of the repetitive work will be automated through Hospitable, PriceLabs and our other systems. I am looking for someone to **manage the operation and exceptions**, not manually perform tasks that software can automate.

 properties?

title: Architectural Designer
description:
A boutique United States architecture firm specializing in high end custom homes, commercial development, adaptive reuse, and interior projects is seeking an experienced Architectural Designer based in the Philippines.

The firm’s approach emphasizes thoughtful design, contextual sensitivity, material quality, sustainability, and the careful integration of design with construction.

The company’s identity and project information will be disclosed to qualified candidates during the interview process.



Position Summary

The Architectural Designer will work remotely with the Principal Architect and project consultants to develop design concepts, prepare architectural drawings, produce construction documents, coordinate project information, and support projects from initial design through construction.

This position requires more than software proficiency. The successful candidate must understand architectural documentation, recognize coordination issues, follow design direction accurately, manage deadlines, and communicate proactively. Candidates must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment without requiring constant supervision.



Primary Responsibilities

Develop architectural plans, elevations, sections, details, diagrams, and presentation materials.

Prepare drawing sets for schematic design, design development, permit submission, bidding, and construction.

Translate sketches, markups, reference materials, and verbal direction from the Principal Architect into accurate architectural documents.

Create three dimensional models, renderings, material studies, and client presentation materials.

Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and constructability before submission.

Research applicable building codes, zoning requirements, planning restrictions, materials, products, and construction methods.

Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior design, landscape, and other consultant documents.

Identify drawing conflicts, missing information, and potential construction issues before they affect a project.

Revise documents based on internal reviews, consultant coordination, agency comments, and construction related questions.

Assist with finish selections, material schedules, door and window schedules, product research, and specification information.

Prepare existing condition drawings from photographs, field measurements, surveys, and reference documents.

Support construction administration by organizing submittals, requests for information, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and project records.

Maintain organized digital project files, drawing standards, model standards, and document naming conventions.

Track assigned tasks and deadlines and provide regular progress updates.

Communicate immediately when instructions are unclear, information is missing, or a deadline may be affected.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.

At least three years of professional experience with an architectural firm or design practice.

Experience preparing architectural drawings and coordinated construction document sets.

Strong understanding of architectural design, detailing, materials, dimensions, and building systems.

Ability to read and coordinate architectural, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Cloud, or closely comparable architectural software.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.

Ability to interpret sketches, redlines, design direction, and technical comments accurately.

Ability to manage multiple assignments without losing track of revisions, deadlines, or unresolved questions.

Reliable computer equipment and a stable, high speed internet connection suitable for large architectural files and remote meetings.

Availability during the agreed working schedule aligned with Pacific Time.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high end residential, hospitality, commercial interior, adaptive reuse, or tenant improvement projects.

Experience working remotely with United States architecture, engineering, or construction firms.

Familiarity with United States building codes, zoning requirements, permitting processes, and architectural drawing standards.

Experience coordinating directly with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and other consultants.

Experience with visualization, rendering, and presentation software.

Familiarity with sustainable design principles and modern building technologies.

Experience supporting projects during permitting and construction.

Familiarity with Bluebeam Revu and cloud based project collaboration platforms.



Professional Expectations

The selected contractor must demonstrate accountability, initiative, accuracy, and consistent follow through.

This role requires someone who can recognize problems instead of simply completing assigned drafting. The contractor must ask informed questions, confirm priorities, maintain organized documentation, and communicate progress without waiting to be contacted.

All project drawings, designs, models, documents, client information, and company information must be treated as confidential. All work produced under this engagement will remain the property of the company.



Application Requirements

Please submit the following:

Current resume

Architectural portfolio

Samples of construction documents or technical drawings

Brief explanation of your specific contribution to each portfolio project

List of software programs and proficiency level

Current location in the Philippines

Available working hours in Pacific Time

Internet speed and computer specifications

Expected monthly contractor rate in Philippine pesos

Earliest available starting date

Candidates whose portfolios only contain academic projects, renderings, or work without a clear explanation of their responsibilities may not be considered.

title: Talent & Contestant Coordinator — Remote
description:
We're HX Media — a production company that creates signature YouTube formats, think Jubilee, Beta Squad, and the Sidemen — produced as a service for brands, companies, and creators. Almost every video we make runs on contestants, which makes casting one of the most important roles in the company. We're looking for a casting person who can take a format brief, understand exactly the kind of person the video needs, then find them, vet them, and get them to set on time — every single shoot. This isn't a generic recruiting job. We have internal SOPs and systems already built out — we need someone who can run them precisely and own the entire contestant pipeline from sourcing to show-up. If you've actually read this, don't forget to include the word "CAST" in your application and subject line.



What you'll be doing



- Understand the narrative of each video and the exact contestant profile it needs — the "who" changes from format to format

- Source contestants through your own outreach, plus the client's audience via Google Forms when available

- Interview every contestant on a call and vet them for the format — for a debate video: do they have strong arguments and the will to defend them? For a guessing video: can they hold up an alias story and sell it believably under pressure?

- Manage contestants all the way to shoot day — sending updates, confirming attendance, double-texting, running regular check-ins, and making sure everyone is at the right location at the right time

- Keep backups ready for every video so a no-show never kills a shoot

Maintain our ClickUp CRM — full notes on every contestant: who they are, their story, what they do

Work inside our SOPs and systems — a lot of the workflow runs through Claude AI, and we'll show you our exact setup



What we're looking for



- Experience in casting, talent booking, recruiting, or community building — or proof you can find and manage people

- Strong people-reading — you can judge in one call whether someone will perform on camera

- Relentless follow-up — confirming, chasing, and re-confirming without dropping balls is the job

- Organised and CRM-disciplined — every contestant logged and up to date in ClickUp

- Great spoken and written English — you'll be interviewing contestants on video calls

- Comfortable using AI tools (Claude) inside an existing system

- Self-sufficient — we hand you the brief, not a lead list



How to apply



1. Watch this Loom ? 

2. Record a Loom of yourself on why you would be a good fit, and include the link in your application

title: Operations & Executive Assistant (Remote – Long-Term)
description:
This is not a typical assistant role.

to complete application, please complete here 



We are building a company where AI handles the routine work, and our people handle the thinking. If you are someone who already works that way — or wants to — this role was built for you.



We are looking for an Operations & Executive Assistant who is as comfortable setting up an AI workflow as they are managing a client invoice or reconciling a vendor bill. Someone who sees a repetitive task and immediately thinks "how do I automate this" rather than "I'll just do it manually every time."



If that is how your mind works, keep reading.



~~~~~~~~~~

~About Us~

We are a Canadian Managed IT Services company supporting 225 devices across 15 business clients. We are growing fast and hiring an Operations, Accounting & Executive Assistant to help remove bottlenecks so our founder can focus on scaling the business from 225 to 500+ endpoints.



The person in this role will not just help us operate — they will help us build systems that let us scale without adding headcount at every step.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Your Mission~

Keep our operations and customers organized, our accounting accurate, our clients well-billed, and our vendor invoices reconciled — while continuously finding smarter, AI-powered ways to get more done with less manual effort.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Work Schedule~

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Flexible schedule with a minimum 4-hour overlap with Pacific Time (Canada)

- You choose your remaining hours within reason



~~~~~~~~~~

~Compensation~

- CAD $600 – $1,200/month depending on experience

- Paid bi-weekly

- End-of-year performance bonus tied to company growth and your contribution to it — the more you help the business grow, the more you share in that success

- Long-term role with a clear path to increased responsibility and pay



~~~~~~~~~~

~Primary Responsibilities~



~Founder Support~

- Manage and organize
 inbox

- Respond to simple client inquiries

- Schedule meetings and follow-ups

- Track action items and tasks

- Prepare weekly operations summaries



~Client Operations~

- Track client users, devices, and licenses for invoicing

- Maintain client records and documentation

- Assist with quoting clients, sourcing prices, Liason with founder and build quote, move quote to order and invoice appropriately and assist on collecting payment



~~~~~~~~~~

~Accounting & Billing — **Core Part of the Role**~

You will own the billing cycle end to end and be the first line of review on all financial activity.  As we have about 15 customers this is important work, yet not the time spent task.  

**2-4 years experience is required.**



~Invoicing & Billing~

- Review Microsoft 365 license counts via Ingram Micro before each billing cycle to ensure every license is accounted for and billed correctly to the right client

- Cross-reference Ingram Micro invoices for hardware and software purchases — confirm what was ordered, delivered, and billed to the client matches

- Prepare accurate client invoices in Wave Accounting

- Review invoice counts and amounts before invoices go out — catch errors before clients see them

- Send client statements and follow up on overdue invoices professionally



~Payments & Deposits~

- Process incoming electronic payments and match them to open client invoices in Wave Accounting

- When the owner deposits a cheque by bank scan, a photo of the cheque will be uploaded to SharePoint — you will be notified and are responsible for marking the deposit against the correct invoice in Wave

- Track all deposits and flag any discrepancies



~Credit Card & Expense Review~

- Regularly review company credit card statements

- Match charges to client accounts or internal cost categories

- Flag any unrecognized or suspicious charges as potential fraud

- Initiate disputes through the appropriate channel when required



~Accounting Inbox

- Monitor and manage the accounting inbox

- Respond to client billing questions and payment inquiries professionally

- Process vendor invoices received by

- Confirm payment receipts and send acknowledgements

- Escalate anything requiring owner decision



~~~~~~~~~~

~Operations Monitoring~

- Monitor support tickets in our Kaseya software stack

- Flag unresolved issues

- Ensure documentation is kept up to date



~~~~~~~~~~

~Growth Support~

- Maintain prospect quotes and follow up

- Help organize proposals

- Help hire and work with Marketing Manager



~~~~~~~~~~

~AI & Automation — Central to This Role~

We do not expect you to do everything manually. We expect you to figure out what AI can do, set it up, manage the output, and escalate only what needs a human decision.



- Identify repetitive tasks and build AI workflows to handle them

- Manage and review AI-generated outputs before they reach clients or the founder

- Continuously look for ways to do more with less manual effort

- Help the company build systems that scale without adding headcount



The goal is not for you to work harder. It is for you to work smarter — and help the whole company do the same.



Over time, your role will shift from doing the work to managing the systems that do the work. That is the direction we are heading, and we want someone who is excited about that future — not threatened by it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~Required Skills~

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Bookkeeping or invoicing experience — you must be comfortable working with numbers and financial records

- Experience with AI tools and automation



~~~~~~~~~~

~Helpful Experience~

- Wave Accounting or similar bookkeeping software

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA or ticketing systems (e.g. Kaseya)

- Distributor or vendor invoice reconciliation

- AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar)



~~~~~~~~~~

~Tools We Use~

- Wave Accounting

- Ingram Micro distributor portal

- Kaseya software stack

- Microsoft 365 and SharePoint

- PSA / ticketing systems

- Spreadsheets and documentation tools

- AI tools — and we are always adding more



~~~~~~~~~~

~Personality We Are Looking For~

- Extremely organized

- Detail-focused — billing errors cost us money and client trust

- Proactive problem solver — you fix things before being asked

- Calm and dependable

- Trustworthy with financial information

- Genuinely excited about building better systems

- You see AI as a tool that makes you more powerful, not a threat to your job

- Reliable, consistent, and self-managed



~~~~~~~~~~

~Weekly Report You Will Own~

- Invoices sent

- Payments received and deposits processed

- Overdue invoices and follow-up status

- Credit card review status and any flagged charges

- Operational issues needing attention

- Priorities for the coming week



~~~~~~~~~~

~Long-Term Opportunity~

As AI takes over more of the routine work, this role grows with it. Your path could lead to:



- Operations Manager

- Finance Coordinator

- Automation & Process Manager



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years, not months — and who wants to be part of building something, not just maintaining it.



~~~~~~~~~~

~How to Apply~

To be considered, your application must include all four of the following:



1. Your experience with operations, admin, or bookkeeping — be specific about what you did

2. The tools you have used — software, platforms, and AI tools

3. A specific example of how you have used AI to save time or improve a process

4. An example of a time you caught a billing or financial error before it became a problem



~Bonus Task — complete this to stand out:~

Review the following client billing summary:



Client A | 12 devices | 10 licenses billed | 12 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue

Client B | 8 devices | 8 licenses billed | 8 on record | Oct 15 | Paid

Client C | 22 devices | 22 licenses billed | 25 on record | Sept 15 | Unpaid | 60 days overdue

Client D | 5 devices | 5 licenses billed | 5 on record | Oct 20 | Paid

Client E | 17 devices | 20 licenses billed | 17 on record | Oct 1 | Unpaid | 45 days overdue



Answer these three questions:



1. Which clients have a billing discrepancy and what is the issue with each?

2. Which clients need immediate payment follow-up and why?

3. How would you use an AI tool to automate the overdue invoice follow-up process so you are managing it rather than writing each
 manually? Describe your approach in 2-3 sentences.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About WANT Branding



WANT Branding is a U.S.-based branding agency that has helped companies build, launch and transform brands for more than 25 years.



We work with CEOs, CMOs and senior marketing leaders on high-value brand strategy, naming, brand identity and research engagements. Our clients range from growing mid-market businesses to some of the world’s largest companies.



We’re looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) in the Philippines to help us identify and develop new business opportunities in the U.S.



The Role



This is not a virtual assistant or administrative role.



We’re looking for an experienced B2B salesperson who is confident picking up the phone, speaking with senior executives and creating qualified sales opportunities.



You’ll research target companies, identify the right decision-makers and conduct thoughtful outbound outreach through phone,
 and LinkedIn.



We care more about quality conversations and qualified opportunities than simply making hundreds of calls.



What You’ll Do



* Research and identify high-potential U.S. companies and decision-makers

* Prospect CEOs, CMOs, VPs of Marketing and other senior executives

* Conduct outbound cold calling

* Create personalized
 and LinkedIn outreach

* Identify potential business and branding needs

* Qualify prospects and book meetings

* Handle initial objections confidently and professionally

* Follow up consistently with prospects

* Maintain accurate prospect and activity information in our CRM

* Work closely with WANT’s Founder & CEO on targeting, messaging and opportunities



Who We’re Looking For



You should have:



* 3+ years of SDR, BDR or B2B outbound sales experience

* Significant experience cold calling U.S. businesses

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confidence speaking with senior executives

* Strong conversational and relationship-building skills

* Experience with lead qualification and objection handling

* Excellent research and prospecting skills

* Experience with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar

* Strong organization and follow-through

* The ability to work independently and take ownership of results



Experience selling professional services, consulting, agencies, marketing services or other high-value B2B services is a major plus.



Working Hours



This is a full-time role serving the U.S. market, so you must be comfortable working hours that provide substantial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

Competitive base compensation based on experience, plus performance-based bonuses for qualified opportunities and new business results.



To Apply

title: Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist
description:
Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist

Full-Time | Remote | Healthcare



Please submit an up-to-date resume. Inquiries will not be considered without a resume. 



Seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Insurance Verification & Authorization Specialist to support U.S.-based healthcare practices on a full-time remote basis. This is a specialized back-office role built for professionals who thrive on accuracy, process, and follow-through, and who understand that getting insurance right the first time directly protects patients and practices alike.



In this role, you will be the primary owner of insurance verification and prior authorization workflows, working closely with front office schedulers, billing teams, and clinical staff to ensure every patient is properly verified and authorized before their appointment. You will communicate regularly with insurance payers, maintain accurate records in the EMR system, and help prevent billing delays, denials, and revenue loss.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Insurance Verification & Eligibility

- Verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits prior to all scheduled appointments

- Confirm coverage details including co-pays, co-insurance, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums, and coverage limitations

- Identify and document patient financial responsibility at least 24 hours before patient arrival

- Update patient files and EMR records with accurate, complete insurance and eligibility information

- Communicate verification results clearly to clinical and administrative staff

- Handle a broad range of insurance types including commercial plans, Medicare, Medicaid, workers' compensation, and auto claims



Prior Authorization & Authorization Management

- Obtain prior authorizations for procedures, therapy visits, and services as required by insurance plans

- Submit authorization requests via phone, payer portals, and electronic systems in a timely manner

- Track authorization approvals, denials, pending requests, and expiration dates in an organized manner

- Follow up proactively on pending authorizations to prevent gaps in care or appointment cancellations

- Renew authorizations as ongoing treatment requires and maintain complete records of all authorization activity

- Escalate unresolved authorization issues to the appropriate internal team member promptly



Payer Communication & Issue Resolution

- Liaise directly with insurance companies via phone and payer portals to clarify coverage, resolve discrepancies, and obtain benefit details

- Assist patients and clinical staff with insurance-related questions and benefit explanations

- Identify and help prevent claim rejections caused by inaccurate or incomplete insurance information

- Assist billing teams with insurance-related documentation, claim support, and records retrieval as needed



Documentation & Administrative Support

- Maintain accurate, organized electronic patient records and insurance documentation in the EMR

- Type, upload, and manage patient forms and insurance-related documents

- Process and organize incoming faxes, referrals, and payer correspondence

- Generate basic reports and tracking logs to support verification workflow oversight

- Maintain strict HIPAA compliance and patient confidentiality at all times

- Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and check-ins as required by the client



QUALIFICATIONS



Required

- 2+ years of experience in medical insurance verification, prior authorization, or a related healthcare administrative role

- Strong working knowledge of insurance terminology, benefit structures, eligibility processes, and payer requirements

- Proven ability to interpret and communicate benefit details accurately to both clinical staff and patients

- Experience working directly with insurance companies via phone and online payer portals

- High attention to detail and a track record of accuracy in data entry and documentation

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, clear phone communication is essential

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage high volumes of verifications and authorizations simultaneously

- Ability to work independently, meet daily targets, and maintain consistent communication with client teams

- Reliable home office setup with a stable internet connection suitable for HIPAA-compliant remote work



Preferred

- Experience supporting U.S.-based outpatient healthcare clinics: physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or similar specialties

- Familiarity with common healthcare EMR platforms (e.g., Prompt, WebPT, Raintree, or similar)

- Experience handling Medicare, workers' compensation, and auto insurance claims

- Background in multi-location or high-volume clinic environments

- Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, or other cloud-based communication and productivity tools



WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- Precision: you catch errors before they become denials, and you take pride in doing it right the first time

- Proactive follow-through: you track open items, follow up without being reminded, and close the loop

- Clear communication: you can explain a complex benefit structure to a patient or a clinic staff member with equal clarity

- Reliability: your client team counts on your daily output, you show up, you deliver, and you flag issues early

- Adaptability: insurance workflows vary by payer and by practice, you learn quickly and adjust without frustration



BENEFITS

- Competitive salary commensurate with experience

- Opportunities for professional development and long-term career growth

- Work within a dynamic, collaborative, and supportive team environment

- Stable, full-time remote employment with U.S.-based healthcare clients

- Make a meaningful impact by ensuring patients receive the care they need without insurance barriers

title: Virtual Assistant – Short-Term Rental Portfolio Manager
description:
STOP. If you do not have a minimum of 5 years of experience managing a short-term rental portfolio, do not apply. Do not send a message. Do not reach out. This role is not for beginners or those transitioning into STR management.



About the Role

We operate a portfolio of 50 short-term rental units across multiple U.S. markets. We are looking for a seasoned, self-sufficient Virtual Assistant who has done this before — at scale — and knows what it takes to run a high-performing STR operation without hand-holding.

This is not a task-taker role. We need a problem-solver who can think independently, anticipate issues before they escalate, and execute without needing constant direction.



You Must Have:

 • 5+ years of hands-on experience managing short-term rental portfolios

 • Active experience on Airbnb, 
, and VRBO — listing management, pricing, guest communication, dispute resolution

 • Experience managing 30+ properties simultaneously

 • Proficiency in at least one Property Management System (PMS) — such as Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, or similar

 • Strong Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets skills for tracking, reporting, and operational organization

 • Fluent English — written and spoken — with professional communication ability

 • Fast, reliable internet connection (this is non-negotiable)

 • Exceptional multitasking and organizational skills — you will be managing guests, owner communications, maintenance coordination, and platform operations simultaneously



What You’ll Actually Be Doing:

 • Managing guest communications across all platforms from inquiry to checkout

 • Monitoring and responding to reviews — flagging issues, crafting responses

 • Coordinating with cleaning teams, maintenance vendors, and local contacts

 • Identifying and resolving guest satisfaction issues proactively

 • Flagging pricing opportunities, calendar gaps, and listing performance issues

 • Escalating only what truly needs escalation — everything else, you handle



Who You Are:

You are organized, fast, and resourceful. You don’t wait to be told what to do — you see a problem and you fix it. You understand that in STR management, your response time and judgment directly affect revenue and reviews. You take ownership.



To Apply:

Do not send a generic application or resume. I will not respond to those.

Instead, send me a direct message with your written answers to the following questions only:



Before we set up a call, would you mind answering these in writing? No need to be formal — short answers are fine.

	1.	Walk me through your background in property management or hospitality operations. How many units, which markets, and what were you personally responsible for?

	2.	What software have you worked in day to day? (PMS like Hospitable/Guesty/Hostaway, Airbnb/Booking/VRBO extranets, pricing tools, cleaning tools like Turno, Slack, spreadsheets, anything else.) Which are you strongest in?

	3.	How comfortable are you learning a new system from scratch — with documentation and a walkthrough, but not hand-holding? Give me a specific example of a tool or process you picked up recently and how long it took you to get fluent.

	4.	Describe how you plan your day. What does your calendar or task list actually look like, and how do you keep things from slipping when five things break at once?

	5.	How do you prioritize when a guest issue, a cleaner no-show and a landlord
 all land in the same hour?

	6.	What are your working hours and time zone, and how do you handle after-hours or weekend escalations? Is that something you’ve done before?

	7.	Are you currently working with other clients or a business of your own? How many hours a week could you realistically commit here?

	8.	Do you have experience managing vendors — cleaners, handymen, contractors? How do you hold them accountable when quality drops?

	9.	How would you rate your spoken English, and how much of your past work involved live phone or video calls with guests, property managers or owners? (Feel free to send a 60–90 second voice note answering questions 1 and 4 — that covers this one too.)

	10.	What does your ideal setup look like — internet speed, backup power/internet, and where you’d be working from?

	11.	What are your compensation expectations, and how soon could you start?



Once I have these I’ll get a call scheduled. Your response to these questions is your application.



We are a growing U.S.-based short-term rental company. This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right person.

We are looking for a talented Copywriter & Content Editor who can take AI-generated content and turn it into clear, engaging, human-sounding copy.

Your job will be to review, edit, refine, and occasionally rewrite AI-generated content so that it feels natural, personal, accurate, and consistent with our brand voice.



This is a great role for someone who loves writing, has a strong eye for detail, understands marketing, and knows the difference between technically correct copy and copy that actually connects with people.



What You'll Do

Edit and polish AI-generated content

Rewrite sections that sound robotic, repetitive, generic, or overly polished

Make content feel conversational, warm, engaging, and human

Maintain a consistent brand voice across all content

Improve headlines, hooks, calls to action, and transitions

Simplify complicated or wordy writing

Check grammar, spelling, punctuation, clarity, and formatting

Remove unnecessary AI-style language, repetition, and filler

Fact-check important claims when needed

Make sure content matches the intended audience and purpose

Occasionally write original copy when AI-generated drafts aren't strong enough



Content may include:



s and
 campaigns

Course lessons and educational content

Social media posts

Blog posts and articles

Lead magnets and PDFs

Sales and marketing copy

Video scripts

Product and offer descriptions

Who We're Looking For



You may be a great fit if you:



Are an excellent writer and editor

Have a strong understanding of conversational marketing copy

Can quickly recognize when something "sounds like AI"

Know how to preserve someone's personality and voice while improving their writing

Have excellent grammar and proofreading skills

Understand the difference between editing for correctness and editing for connection

Can take a rough draft and make it significantly better without unnecessarily rewriting everything

Are comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT

Are organized, dependable, and able to meet deadlines

Can receive feedback and quickly adapt to a specific brand voice

Bonus Skills



Not required, but we'd love experience with:



 marketing

Digital marketing

Online courses

Social media marketing

Sales copywriting

SEO content

ChatGPT or other AI writing tools

GoHighLevel

Canva

What Success Looks Like



The best compliment we could give you is:



"You'd never know AI helped write this."



We want someone who can use AI as a starting point while making sure the finished content still has personality, emotion, clarity, and a real human voice.

We're looking for someone who can make good content great—and make AI-assisted content feel genuinely human.
