title: Social Media Manager
description:
About us

Tell Studios is a video production company in Orion Township, Michigan. Our tagline is "video with soul," and we mean it — we help businesses and personal brands find the story underneath what they do, then bring it to life on camera. Twenty years in, we've made films for Adventures by Disney, the University of Michigan, the American Cancer Society, and a long list of businesses you've never heard of but whose stories deserved telling.



We're a small team that takes the work seriously and ourselves less so. One of our core beliefs is "done is better than perfect" — we'd rather ship something real and learn from it than polish something forever. That belief matters a lot in this role.



The three brands you'd be running. This role covers our whole family of brands, so range matters more here than depth in any one lane:



Tell Studios — our video production company. Audience: marketing directors, communications leads, and business owners in the Midwest and beyond. Tone: confident, warm, story-first.



Ryan Koral — our founder's personal brand. Audience: business owners and creators who want to show up on video. Tone: personal, encouraging, occasionally a dad joke.



Studio Sherpas — our coaching and podcast brand for video business owners. Audience: filmmakers and studio owners building their businesses. Tone: peer-to-peer, practical, insider.



Three brands, three very different audiences. Being able to move between them without everything sounding the same is the single most important thing we're hiring for.



Down the road, this may also include managing social for a select client or two — we have clients asking. That's not day one, but it's where this is heading.



What this role actually is

We want to be direct about this, because it's where these hires usually go wrong.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be writing the captions, building the carousels, cutting the clips, and hitting schedule — yourself. There's no one below you to hand things to.



It's also not a role where you wait to be told what to post. You'll own the calendar and the output, and you'll be the one telling us what belongs on it. We want someone with real opinions about what should go out and the ability to make it themselves.

If you're looking for a role where you build the strategy deck and someone else executes it, this isn't that. If you're looking for a role where you just run someone else's calendar, this isn't that either.



What you'll own

The calendar and the output. Content pillars, posting cadence, platform priorities. Writing the copy, designing the graphics and carousels, scheduling everything, and staying consistent.



Turning our library into posts. We're sitting on years of client testimonials, workshop footage, podcast episodes, and behind-the-scenes material that has never been properly mined. A huge part of this job is finding the gold in there and getting it out into the world.



Telling Ryan what to shoot. This one's important. Ryan makes more content when someone hands him a plan. We want you maintaining the idea backlog and showing up with "here's what we're shooting this week, here are the three things to talk about, here's the shot list." You'd be driving the content engine, not waiting at the end of it.



Reading the data and acting on it. We want someone who actually looks at the numbers and lets them change the plan — noticing that carousels are outperforming single images, that one hook style keeps landing, that a whole format isn't working and should be killed. You'll report back regularly on what's working, what isn't, and what you want to try next. You don't need to be a data analyst. You do need to be someone who forms an opinion from a dashboard and then does something about it.



Pulling what you need from our team. When a post needs a specific clip, you'll brief our editors directly — clearly enough that they can deliver it without a dozen follow-up messages.

Proactive communication. Regular updates, flagging problems early, no guessing games on our end.



What we're looking for

Taste. You have a point of view about what good looks like. We'd love to hire someone who doesn't just match our brand voices but sharpens them.



Range across brand voices. You can write as a video production company, as a personal creator, and as a coach for filmmakers — and they sound like three different people.



Proven experience running accounts end to end. Portfolio required. We especially want to see accounts you owned start to finish, not one slice of an agency workflow.



Comfort with analytics. You can read native platform insights and a scheduling dashboard, draw a conclusion, and change what you're doing because of it.



Design ability. Carousels, quote graphics, story frames — Canva-level is fine, we're not asking for a designer.

Basic short-form editing. Trimming clips, adding captions, cutting a Reel from existing footage.



Excellent written English. You'll be writing in our voice, publicly, every day.



Full-time and focused. This is your one job. We're not looking for someone splitting attention across other clients or gigs, and we pay at the top of the market specifically so we don't have to.



You do NOT need to: edit long-form YouTube videos, run paid ad campaigns, shoot anything yourself, or have worked in video production before.



Bonus points for: experience with video-heavy brands, podcast clip workflows, or growing a short-form account from a standing start.



The details

Compensation: 1,200–1,500 USD/month, depending on experience, paid monthly.

Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week).

Hours: Async-first — we care about output, not hours logged. Two fixed requirements: a weekly Connect call with your manager (who works US Eastern hours), and roughly two hours of scheduled overlap on two or three other days for feedback rounds. Beyond that, you set your own schedule. If you'd rather work full US Eastern hours, that works for us too.

Tools we use: Metricool, Canva, Google Workspace, Descript, Slack. Experience with these is a plus, not a requirement.

Start date: As soon as possible



Where this goes

We're building this function from close to scratch, and we'd rather grow someone into it than hire a title. If you run these three brands well, the natural next step is client work and eventually a small team underneath you. We're not promising that on day one — but it's real, and it's why we're hiring above market instead of at it.



How to apply

Reply with the subject line: SMM — [Your Name] — [a brand whose social you admire]



Include:

Your portfolio — 2–3 accounts you personally ran. Tell us what changed while you were running them.

A 60-second unscripted video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Nothing fancy, phone camera is fine. We just want to meet you.



One short answer: Pick one of our three brands, look at what we're currently doing, and tell us the first three posts you'd make and why. A few sentences each is plenty.



Applications missing the video or the short answer won't be reviewed.



Our process: a short intro call, then a small paid test project across two of our brand voices, then a decision. We don't ask anyone to work for free.

title: Short Form Video Editor (Trends, Memes, Comedy Timing) — Full-Time PST
description:
Drax Social is a US-based full-service short form video marketing agency. We handle strategy, production, shooting, editing, and social media management for our brand clients. We're looking for a short form video editor who lives and breathes internet culture.



READ THIS FIRST. This is not a podcast editing role. This is not a talking-head role. If that's your background, this isn't the fit. We need someone who understands trends, memes, comedic timing, and how to make content that actually performs on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. This is non-negotiable.



You must also work full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday, on US Pacific (PST) hours. This is non-negotiable. We need a daytime editor on our schedule.



One more non-negotiable: NO SPELLING MISTAKES. If we see a single spelling error in your application, captions, or graphics, it's an automatic no. Attention to detail is everything in this role.



Who you are:



You're chronically online in the best way. You get memes, jokes, timing, and trends before they peak.

You understand comedic timing and know how to cut for a laugh, a pause, or a punchline.

You can take old footage and reformat it into a new trend because you understand why the trend works.

You adapt your editing style to different clients. We have a range, and you need to read the brief and match the vibe.



What you'll edit:



Short form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

Man-on-the-street (MOTS) style videos

Trend-based content and meme formats

B-roll driven pieces

Recipe and product videos

Mostly iPhone footage, with occasional camera footage



What you need to know:



Premiere Pro and/or After Effects

Graphics, motion graphics, animation, and special effects when a project calls for it

Clean captions and text with perfect spelling and good timing

How to match pacing and style to the platform and the client



Style references (this is the kind of content we make):



MOTS: 

Trends: 

B-roll: 

Recipe videos: 



Watch these before applying. If this style excites you, you're probably a fit. If it doesn't, you probably aren't.



HOW TO APPLY:



Read carefully, this is how we filter for people who actually pay attention.



Start your message with the word "PUNCHLINE" as the very first word. Applications that don't start with this word will be deleted without being read.



Then send:



A portfolio or resume with a FEW relevant links to short form work you've edited (trends, memes, MOTS, comedy, product, or recipe content). Do NOT send us a giant folder or 500 Google Drive links. Send 3 to 5 of your best, most relevant pieces that match what we do.



Answers to these questions:

1. Why are you the right editor for THIS kind of content? Be specific about your relationship to trends and comedic timing.

2. How long have you been editing short form video?

3. What's your overall editing experience? Walk us through your background.

4. Who have you edited for? List any creators, brands, or companies you've worked with that are relevant to the trend, meme, comedy, or short form style we do.

5. Confirm you can work full-time, 8 hours a day, Monday to Friday, on US Pacific (PST) hours. What time would that be for you locally?

6, Are you open to doing a short test edit as part of the hiring process? (Yes/No)



Only complete applications that start with "PUNCHLINE," include relevant portfolio links, and answer all questions will be considered.

title: Outbound Telesales Representative
description:
B2B Tech Appointment Setter - Part-Time (2 Hours/Day) - UK Market



Position: Outbound B2B Appointment Setter (Freelance/Contract)



Industry: Artificial Intelligence and Software Development



Hours: 10 Hours/Week (Monday to Friday, 09:30 AM - 11:30 AM UK Time)

Compensation: Competitive Hourly Base Rate + High-Upside Commission on Closed Deals



About the Opportunity

Artificial Intelligence is changing the world, and companies across the United Kingdom are actively seeking ways to leverage it. At our AI Software Development Agency, we design custom, cutting-edge AI solutions and agentic workflows that solve complex operational problems for mid-sized enterprises.



We are expanding our outbound outreach and looking for an elite, articulate, and persuasive B2B Tech Appointment Setter. This is a highly focused, premium prospecting role requiring just 2 hours per day during peak morning dialing hours in the UK. 



If you are a high-performing sales professional looking for a flexible, high-leverage micro-shift in the tech space, this is for you.

Your sole mission? Open doors, bypass gatekeepers, spark curiosity about AI capabilities, and secure high-quality phone appointments for our senior technical consultants.



Key Responsibilities

1. Targeted Outbound Prospecting: Execute high-volume, premium cold calls to C-level executives, CTOs, CIOs, and Operations Directors at medium-sized UK enterprises.

2. Intelligent Qualification: Move past basic scripts to uncover structural business friction points that our custom AI agents can solve.

3.Appointment Setting: Successfully secure and schedule dedicated phone consultations between qualified UK prospects and our core consultancy team.

4. Pipeline Tracking: Keep structured, clean notes on call outcomes, decision-maker contact details, and follow-up timelines.



What We Are Looking For

To excel in this role, you must bring a consultative, high-intelligence approach to tech sales. We are seeking candidates who possess:

1. Stellar English and Communication: Flawless verbal English with a polished, engaging, and authoritative phone manner capable of holding peer-level conversations with corporate executives.

2. Proven B2B Sales Track Record: Verifiable outbound cold-calling experience. You must be able to demonstrate a history of hitting dial targets and overcoming tough objections.

3. Technical Sales Fluency: Previous experience in software, SaaS, cloud, or technical IT sales is highly preferred. You should feel comfortable using terms like automation workflows, software integrations, and ROI efficiency.

4. UK Market Familiarity: An understanding of UK business culture, etiquette, and time zones is a massive advantage.



What Is in it for You?

1. High-Leverage Hours: Earn a competitive hourly baseline while working only 2 hours a day-perfect for balancing with other projects or lifestyle commitments.

2. Aggressive Commission Structure: We do not just reward you for setting the meeting. In addition to your base pay, you will receive a significant cash bonus for every meeting you book that converts into an agency contract. Selling high-ticket custom AI services means your commission potential is immense. 

3. Cutting-Edge Industry: Gain direct exposure to the booming generative AI and agentic software industry alongside an expert development team.



How to Apply (Mandatory Requirements)

We prioritize performance and professionalism above all else. To be considered for an interview, your application must include the following three details:

1. A Verifiable Reference: Provide a contact name, company name, or reference letter explicitly stating your sales track record (e.g., how many cold calls you executed, or how many qualified B2B meetings/deals you closed in a previous sales campaign).

2. Daily Call Capacity: Based on a focused 2-hour morning window, state realistically how many high-quality, outbound corporate dials you can execute.

3. Your Cold Calling Approach: Give us a brief 2-3 sentence summary of your experience with cold calling into technical or corporate environments, highlighting how you handle gatekeepers or initial rejection.

title: Head of Casting — Jubilee-Style YouTube Formats
description:
We're HX Media — a production company that creates signature YouTube formats, think Jubilee, Beta Squad, and the Sidemen — produced as a service for brands, companies, and creators. Almost every video we make runs on contestants, which makes casting one of the most important roles in the company. We're looking for a casting person who can take a format brief, understand exactly the kind of person the video needs, then find them, vet them, and get them to set on time — every single shoot. This isn't a generic recruiting job. We have internal SOPs and systems already built out — we need someone who can run them precisely and own the entire contestant pipeline from sourcing to show-up. If you've actually read this, don't forget to include the word "CAST" in your application and subject line.



What you'll be doing



- Understand the narrative of each video and the exact contestant profile it needs — the "who" changes from format to format

- Source contestants through your own outreach, plus the client's audience via Google Forms when available

- Interview every contestant on a call and vet them for the format — for a debate video: do they have strong arguments and the will to defend them? For a guessing video: can they hold up an alias story and sell it believably under pressure?

- Manage contestants all the way to shoot day — sending updates, confirming attendance, double-texting, running regular check-ins, and making sure everyone is at the right location at the right time

- Keep backups ready for every video so a no-show never kills a shoot

Maintain our ClickUp CRM — full notes on every contestant: who they are, their story, what they do

Work inside our SOPs and systems — a lot of the workflow runs through Claude AI, and we'll show you our exact setup



What we're looking for



- Experience in casting, talent booking, recruiting, or community building — or proof you can find and manage people

- Strong people-reading — you can judge in one call whether someone will perform on camera

- Relentless follow-up — confirming, chasing, and re-confirming without dropping balls is the job

- Organised and CRM-disciplined — every contestant logged and up to date in ClickUp

- Great spoken and written English — you'll be interviewing contestants on video calls

- Comfortable using AI tools (Claude) inside an existing system

- Self-sufficient — we hand you the brief, not a lead list



How to apply



1. Watch this Loom ?

title: Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Elite-level Internet Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist with proven experience handling difficult and high-profile online reputation cases. We work with high-profile individuals, including celebrities, executives, public figures, and brands, and we need someone who understands how to handle reputation issues that can spread rapidly across the internet.



This is not a traditional SEO or social media position. We are looking for someone experienced in advanced content removal, search suppression, de-indexing, takedown coordination, and reputation recovery.



To give you a better understanding of the type of cases we handle:

Imagine a high-profile celebrity such as Beyoncé has an embarrassing i
 during a live performance. Someone records the i
, uploads the video, and within hours the footage is being reposted across Google, social media, news websites, and other platforms. We are looking for a specialist who understands how to approach a situation like this and legitimately pursue removal of the original and replicated content wherever possible, while also addressing the resulting search visibility. This is the level of complexity and urgency we are looking for—not simply removing a negative review or improving a Google ranking.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute advanced ORM strategies

- Identify the source and spread of damaging content

- Pursue legitimate content removal and takedown opportunities

- Evaluate available Google and platform removal processes

- Develop search-suppression strategies when removal is not possible

- Coordinate with publishers, platforms, and legal counsel when appropriate

- Develop authoritative content to strengthen positive search results

- Monitor Google rankings, indexing, and search visibility

- Provide regular reports and recommendations



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management

- Viral or high-profile content removal

- Search-result suppression

- Google de-indexing and removal processes

- Website and platform takedowns

- Legal/policy-based removal requests

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Reputation management for celebrities, executives, or public figures

- Complex cases involving news websites, social platforms, government websites, court records, or other authoritative sources



We are not looking for someone who only has basic SEO, backlink building, keyword research, or Google review management experience. We need someone who has actually handled complex ORM cases and can demonstrate real results.



To Apply, please provide:

- Your Resume

- Your ORM experience

- Examples of difficult cases you have handled

- Results you achieved

- Your experience with content removal, de-indexing, or search suppression

- Case studies, screenshots, or other proof of results where possible



If you have experience handling high-profile, viral, or difficult online reputation problems, we want to hear from you.

Successful candidates may have the opportunity to work with us on a long-term basis, with potential for a full-time position.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
About Us

At Atlas Brands, we're building 10 high-velocity DTC brands that are rewriting what fast growth looks like.

We currently operate 2 brands and are adding 8 more brands within the next 2 months. That means we're not building around a single product or account - we're building a portfolio of brands and a team capable of scaling them at extraordinary speed.

To support this growth, we're looking for a CRO Specialist with hands-on DTC experience who can turn data, customer behaviour, and business objectives into structured experimentation and measurable improvements in conversion and revenue.



The Role

As a CRO Specialist, you'll work closely with the CRO Manager to execute and scale our CRO program across multiple ecommerce brands.

This is a hands on operator role.

You'll be responsible for taking CRO initiatives from brief ? build ? QA ? launch ? analysis ? iteration, while also contributing to the strategy behind what we test and why.

You won't be expected to own the entire CRO strategy from day one. The CRO Manager will provide the broader strategic direction and prioritisation, while you'll own the day to day execution and progressively take on more strategic responsibility as you demonstrate strong judgement and results.

We're looking for someone who doesn't need to be told what to do at every step.

If you're given an objective, we want you to be able to figure out how to get it done, communicate what you need, identify problems before they become blockers, and come back with recommendations - not just questions.

As we scale from 2 to 10 brands, there is significant opportunity for this role to grow into a larger CRO and experimentation responsibility.



Day-to-Day Responsibilities

1. CRO Execution & Implementation

This will be the largest part of your role.

Set up and manage A/B tests and experiments from approved briefs through to launch.

Build and implement CRO initiatives across our ecommerce brands.

Build and modify pages, funnels, offers, and other CRO experiences.

Set up and manage checkout, PDP, landing-page, and funnel experiences as required.

Set up new pages and offers required for CRO initiatives and brand launches.

Work with developers to turn CRO requirements into functioning experiences.

Ensure experiments and website changes are implemented accurately and according to the brief.

QA new pages, funnels, offers, and experiments before they go live.

Test across relevant devices and user journeys to make sure nothing breaks or creates friction.

Monitor websites and funnels after launches to identify bugs, implementation issues, or unexpected behaviour.

Review Hotjar recordings, logs, and other behavioural data to identify customer friction and opportunities.

Coordinate tracking, pixels, and analytics implementation with the relevant technical team.

Troubleshoot issues and work with developers to get them resolved quickly.

The expectation: once a CRO test has been approved, you should be able to take ownership of getting it from idea to a properly functioning live experience.



2. CRO Analysis & Experimentation

While execution is the core of the role, we also want you thinking like a CRO strategist.

Monitor performance across assigned brands and flag meaningful changes or conversion issues.

Analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify CRO opportunities.

Develop clear CRO hypotheses based on data, customer behaviour, research, and business objectives.

Support the development and maintenance of experimentation roadmaps.

Analyse test results and identify meaningful learnings and follow up opportunities.

Document experiments, results, and learnings so insights compound across brands.

Recommend follow up tests based on experiment results rather than treating each test as an isolated event.

Identify opportunities to improve conversion rate, AOV, revenue per visitor, and overall funnel performance.

Challenge existing assumptions and bring new testing ideas to the CRO Manager.

Continuously improve your understanding of what works across our brands and apply those learnings where relevant.

You don't need to come in with the answer to everything.

We do expect you to think, investigate, and bring something to the table.

3. Project & Development Management

You'll also act as the day-to-day handler for CRO-related development work.

Own the CRO execution pipeline and ensure projects continue moving forward.

Act as the primary point of coordination between the CRO team and developers for assigned initiatives.

Translate CRO briefs and requirements into clear development tasks.

Coordinate timelines, dependencies, revisions, QA, and launches.

Follow up on outstanding development work and proactively identify blockers.

Ensure developers have everything they need to execute correctly.

Review completed work against the original brief before considering an initiative ready for launch.

Communicate delays, issues, and risks to the CRO Manager early rather than waiting for them to become problems.

Help improve the systems and processes we use to manage a high volume of CRO initiatives across multiple brands.

We want someone who handles problems rather than passes them upward.

3. Scaling CRO Operation

We're building toward 10 brands, which means the way we work today won't be enough tomorrow.

You'll work with the CRO Manager and technical team to:

Improve the speed and efficiency of the CRO workflow.

Identify repetitive processes that can be automated.

Help build AI-powered systems and workflows that reduce manual work and errors.

Improve experiment documentation and knowledge sharing.

Develop better QA and launch processes.

Identify bottlenecks across research, build, testing, analysis, and implementation.

Help create systems that allow the CRO team to operate effectively across a growing portfolio of brands.

This is where we expect the role to grow beyond pure execution.

The better you understand the business and demonstrate good judgement, the more ownership you'll be able to take.

What You’ll Gain



Hands-on experience across a portfolio of rapidly growing DTC brands.

Direct exposure to the full CRO lifecycle, from strategy through execution and analysis.

Experience building and launching real ecommerce experiments rather than only producing recommendations.

Close collaboration with experienced CRO strategists, media buyers, designers, developers, and growth specialists.

Deep development across CRO, experimentation, customer psychology, analytics, implementation, and project management.

Exposure to a high-volume experimentation environment.

The opportunity to help build the systems and processes required to scale CRO across 10 brands.

Increasing ownership and responsibility as you prove yourself.

A clear path toward a Senior CRO Specialist / CRO Strategy role as the company scales.



What Success Looks Like

In this role, success isn't simply running a certain number of tests.

A successful CRO Specialist will:

Get CRO initiatives shipped quickly and correctly.

Keep experiments and development projects moving without constant follow-up from the CRO Manager.

Catch bugs and implementation issues before they reach customers.

Produce clean, reliable experiment setups and QA.

Use data and customer behaviour to identify meaningful opportunities.

Develop strong hypotheses rather than random test ideas.

Turn experiment results into actionable next steps.

Communicate clearly and proactively.

Take ownership when something goes wrong.

Gradually become capable of owning larger parts of the CRO process independently.

Must-Have Skills & Experience



1-2 years of experience in CRO, experimentation & optimisation role.

Hands-on experience developing hypotheses and managing A/B or split tests.

Strong analytical ability with the confidence to interpret data and turn findings into actionable recommendations.

Must have experience working with CRO tools & platforms like Intelligems & Heatmaps or similar ones.

Ability to QA pages, funnels, and experiments and identify implementation issues before launch.

Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple experiments, projects, and priorities simultaneously.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Basic understanding of analytics, tracking, and pixel implementation.

Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Fluent in English.

A strong bias toward action, ownership, and continuous improvement.



Preferred Experience



Previous experience working with ecommerce brands or from CRO agency background.

Experience working with Phoenix or similar ecommerce/checkout platforms.

Familiarity with analytics and experimentation platforms such as Intelligems or similar tools.

Experience using Heatmap, Hotjar or similar behavioural analytics/session recording tools.

Experience troubleshooting website, funnel, or tracking issues.

Experience coordinating or managing developers on CRO projects.

Familiarity with established CRO frameworks and methodologies.

Experience working closely with designers and media buying teams.

CRO certifications or formal training, such as CXL.



Why This Role?

This role is ideal for someone who loves turning data into action and learning through experimentation.

If you enjoy structured problem-solving, testing ideas instead of guessing, and seeing your work directly influence business growth, you’ll have the opportunity to take meaningful ownership across multiple brands.

You’ll be joining at an unusually early stage of our expansion, with the chance to help build the systems, experimentation processes, and CRO engine that will support 10 DTC brands.



Perks



Competitive salary package based on experience.

Company wide reward and incentive scheme.

Comprehensive training and support.

Regular performance reviews and goal setting.

Flexible working hours.

Regular rewards and sprint initiatives.

Supportive, performance-driven team environment.



Our Hiring Process



Application Review

Initial Interview: Share your goals, get an insight into our culture, and explore alignment

Paid Assessment : We send you an assessment that is paid, to evaluate your process of thinking.

Technical Interview: Real scenarios to demonstrate your strategic thinking & technical fit

Offer: Align on role expectations, growth pathways, and long-term success





How to Apply

If this excite you or this is the role that you are looking for as a next step in your career. Please Apply using the link: 

Join us at an exciting stage of our growth - we’re looking forward to meeting you.

title: Podcast Video Editor — Multi-Camera, Quick Turnaround
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Q's Recording Studios (QRS) is a music production studio and media company producing Cue The Q Podcast, along with artist content, music videos, and social content for independent musicians. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented video editor to handle our podcast episodes and supporting social content on an ongoing basis.

- Cut long-form episodes into short-form clips for YouTube Shorts, Reels, and TikTok

- Design and deliver custom thumbnails for each episode

- Export correctly formatted files for each platform (16:9 for YouTube, 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, 1:1 if needed)

- Maintain consistent color, pacing, and audio quality across all deliverables

- Organize and manage project files/media in an agreed folder structure

- Turn around edits on a fast, predictable timeline once workflow is established

- Keep all footage and unreleased content confidential — this includes unreleased guest interviews and unpublished material



REQUIREMENTS

- Must show a portfolio or demo reel — prior podcast or multi-camera interview editing strongly preferred

- Strong understanding of pacing, cutting on dialogue, and keeping viewers engaged through a long-form conversation

- Comfortable working with multi-camera footage and syncing multiple audio sources

- Experience color matching footage from different cameras

- Experience creating thumbnails (Photoshop or similar)

- Reliable, communicative, and able to meet deadlines consistently

- Efficient — able to work quickly without sacrificing quality once templates and workflows are set



SOFTWARE

- DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred

- Premiere Pro or Final Cut acceptable if portfolio quality is strong

- Comfortable with large file transfer and shared drives (Google Drive, 
, or similar)



TO APPLY

Please include all of the following in your application:

1. Link to your portfolio or demo reel (podcast or multi-camera editing preferred)

2. Your typical turnaround time per episode

3. In your own words, describe your process for editing a multi-camera podcast episode from raw footage to final export

title: SQUARESPACE WEBSITE DESIGNER + CONVERSION COPYWRITER
description:
Creative Experience Brand | Project With Ongoing Work



Please read the entire post before applying. Generic applications will not be considered.



ABOUT PRESENT WONDERS



Present Wonders creates guided, playful painting experiences for private groups, families, celebrations, retreats, and workplace teams.



It is not an art class. Painting is the medium for an experience built around play, connection, surprise, and discovering that you are more creative than you thought.



The workshops are based in Santa Monica, California.



THE PROJECT



I have an existing Squarespace website, marketing collateral, workshop photographs, testimonials, and developing copy.



I am looking for someone who can review everything with fresh eyes and help me d
:



• Who the website is speaking to

• What visitors need to understand immediately

• How the workshops should be organized and presented

• What content should remain, change, move, or disappear

• How to turn visitor interest into inquiries and bookings

• How the website and marketing materials should look and feel as one brand



This may be a substantial update or a redesign within my existing Squarespace site. I do not want to move to WordPress, Wix, Webflow, or another platform.



This is not a one-time “make it pretty” assignment. I want to develop an ongoing relationship with someone who can refine the site as I get better photography, video, testimonials, offers, and language.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Audit my existing Squarespace website

• Review my current flyers, one-sheets, photographs, testimonials, and copy

• Identify problems with positioning, navigation, messaging, visual hierarchy, and calls to action

• Recommend a clearer website structure

• Help refine and edit the copy

• Design or redesign pages directly in Squarespace

• Create a strong visual system for typography, color, spacing, buttons, imagery, and page layouts

• Make the site work well on desktop, tablet, and mobile

• Build clear paths for different audiences without making the site confusing

• Improve inquiry, booking, and contact calls to action

• Prepare the site to accept stronger photography and video as those assets become available

• Make periodic updates after the initial project



The initial audiences may include:



• Private celebrations and birthdays

• Brides and bachelorette groups

• Families and adult family groups

• Workplace and leadership teams

• Retreat and community organizers



Part of your job will be helping determine which audiences belong together and which require separate pages or messages.



THE PERSON I AM LOOKING FOR



You must have:



• Strong, current Squarespace experience, including Fluid Engine

• A portfolio of Squarespace websites you personally designed and built

• Strong visual taste and command of typography, spacing, imagery, and hierarchy

• Experience with service businesses, experience brands, consultants, workshops, retreats, hospitality, events, or personal brands

• The ability to make a service understandable and desirable

• Strong English writing and editing skills

• An understanding of conversion-focused website design

• The ability to explain your design and content choices

• Comfort working iteratively as the brand, copy, and visual assets improve

• Good judgment about when AI helps and when human taste must take over



You may use AI for research, ideation, wireframes, copy exploration, image concepts, or workflow support. The finished website must feel original, intentional, and human—not like an AI-generated template.



THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT PROJECT IF



• You mainly install and modify templates

• Your portfolio is attractive but the websites do not clearly sell anything

• You need finished copy and a complete brand guide before beginning

• You specialize in e-commerce product stores rather than service businesses

• You design in Figma but cannot implement the work accurately in Squarespace

• Your writing relies heavily on generic marketing language

• You recommend changing platforms instead of working within Squarespace

• You cannot show live websites that you personally built



HOW TO APPLY



Use this application title:



PRESENT WONDERS WEBSITE — [YOUR FIRST NAME]



Begin your application with:



“Painting is the medium, but the experience is the product.”



Then provide all of the following:



1. LINKS TO THREE LIVE SQUARESPACE WEBSITES



These must be websites you personally designed and built.



For each website, explain:



• What the business sells

• What you personally did

• Whether you created or edited the copy

• Whether you began with a template, redesigned an existing site, or built it from the ground up

• What business problem the redesign was intended to solve

• Whether the client can confirm your involvement



Please identify which Squarespace version or editor was used.



2. ONE SERVICE-BUSINESS CASE STUDY



Show one example of a website that had to sell an experience, expertise, or service rather than a physical product.



Explain:



• What was unclear before

• What you changed

• How you organized the information

• How you d
 what belonged on the homepage

• What action you wanted visitors to take

• Any measurable improvement in inquiries, bookings, calls, or conversions



Before-and-after screenshots are strongly preferred.



3. SHORT VIDEO REVIEW



Record a three- to five-minute Loom video reviewing my current website:







Please address only these questions:



• What do you believe Present Wonders is selling?

• What is the biggest point of confusion?

• What is the first thing you would change?

• Which existing element should be preserved?

• What information do you need from me before recommending a redesign?



Do not provide a complete redesign or create free sample pages.



4. WRITING SAMPLE



Choose one heading or paragraph from my current website. Show:



• The original wording

• Your edited version

• A brief explanation of why you changed it



5. WORKING RELATIONSHIP



Tell me:



• Your hourly rate and typical project rate

• Your current availability

• Your estimated timeframe for an initial audit and redesign

• How you manage feedback and revisions

• Whether you personally do all design, writing, and Squarespace work

• Which work, if any, you subcontract

• What AI tools you use and how you use them

• Your preferred process for ongoing website updates



Applications missing any requested item will not be considered.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio and application review

2. Short video interview

3. Paid website and marketing-material audit

4. Agreement on redesign scope, timeline, and price

5. Initial design phase

6. Squarespace build and mobile review

7. Ongoing updates as new content becomes available



This is initially a project-based position with the potential for a long-term working relationship. I am looking for judgment, taste, clarity, and Squarespace ability—not the lowest price.

I am looking for someone who can eventually take ownership of several repeatable parts of my business, including Amazon Creator Connections outreach, brand communication, product tracking, product research, video editing, and cross-posting content across multiple platforms.



I will provide training, written processes, templates, and examples for the Amazon-specific tasks. You do not need to know everything on day one, but you must be comfortable learning new systems and following detailed instructions.



I am looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with the business.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon Creator Connections & Brand Outreach



You will help manage our daily product and brand outreach process.



Tasks will include:



* Run product searches using specific parameters I provide

* Review product opportunities generated from those searches

* Accept qualifying Amazon Creator Connections campaigns

* Send bulk outreach messages to brands using templates I provide

* Monitor incoming brand messages and respond professionally

* Follow up with brands when appropriate

* Track which brands agree to send products

* Enter incoming products into a Google Form/Google Sheet so we maintain an accurate inventory of products being sent

* Keep outreach and product records organized and up to date



You will not be expected to d
 our overall strategy on your own. I will provide the criteria and systems; I need someone who can execute them accurately and consistently.



Product Research



I also want someone who enjoys researching products and spotting opportunities.



You will:



* Research products that may be strong opportunities for Amazon Influencer review videos

* Evaluate products using criteria and tools I provide

* Look for products with strong sales potential and favorable competition

* Create organized lists of potential products for me to review before purchasing

* Learn over time what makes a product worth creating content around



Strong analytical skills and curiosity are a big plus here.



Video Editing & Social Media



I will provide raw video footage. You will turn that footage into polished short-form content and help distribute it across our social platforms.



Tasks may include:



* Edit raw footage using CapCut

* Create short-form videos for Instagram Reels,
 Reels/Stories, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube

* Add captions, text, cuts, music, B-roll, and other simple editing elements when appropriate

* Cross-post existing Amazon review videos to Pinterest and YouTube

* Work through my existing video library and repurpose older content

* Post/schedule approved content to social platforms

* Help organize our content library so videos can easily be reused

* Eventually cross-post eligible Amazon videos to additional international Amazon storefronts as those accounts become available



The goal is to take content I have already filmed and help me get much more value and reach from each video.



MUST-HAVES



* Strong written English

* Excellent attention to detail

* Highly organized and comfortable working with Google Sheets and Google Forms

* Experience editing short-form video

* Experience with CapCut or ability to learn it quickly

* Comfortable working with Instagram,
, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube

* Comfortable learning new software, Chrome extensions, and online tools

* Able to follow written SOPs and repeat processes accurately

* Comfortable communicating professionally with brands

* Able to manage repetitive, high-volume tasks without losing accuracy

* Reliable internet connection

* Communicates consistently during working hours

* Takes feedback well and applies it going forward

* Interested in a long-term working relationship



NICE TO HAVE — BUT NOT REQUIRED



Experience with any of the following is a major plus:



* Amazon Influencer Program

* Amazon Creator Connections

* Amazon Seller Central

* Amazon product research

* Keepa

* Online arbitrage or Amazon FBA

* Pinterest marketing

* YouTube

* Instagram/Facebook content management

* TikTok

* Canva

* CapCut

* Social media scheduling tools



Please do not skip applying simply because you have never worked with Amazon Creator Connections. I am willing to train the right person.



HOURS



Please tell me:



* How many hours per week you are currently available

* What hours you normally work

* Your time zone

* Whether you are available for occasional weekend work

* Whether you currently work for any other clients



There is an opportunity for hours and responsibilities to increase as the business grows.



COMPENSATION



Pay will be based on experience, skills, and availability.



There is room for increased responsibility and compensation for someone who proves they can take ownership of these systems and consistently produce high-quality work.



TO APPLY



Start your subject line with the word MAGNOLIA. Applications without this keyword are deleted and unread.

Applications that do not include this word will not be considered.



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your VA experience

2. Your experience with Amazon, product research, brand outreach, or e-commerce

3. Your experience editing videos and which editing programs you use

4. Which social media platforms you have managed for clients

5. A link to 2–3 videos you have personally edited

6. Your experience with Google Sheets

7. Your current availability and preferred working hours

8. Your expected hourly rate

9. Your internet speed or a screenshot from Speedtest.net

10. Tell me about one repetitive task you managed for a previous client and how you made sure mistakes did not happen



Bonus question: If you were given 200 potential Amazon products to research, how would you organize the process so the best opportunities were reviewed first?



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to a short video interview.



Final candidates may be given a small paid test project involving organization, product research, brand communication, and/or video editing.



I am not looking for someone for a few weeks. I want to find the right person, train them in our systems, and build a long-term working relationship as the business grows.

title: Appliance Repair Dispatcher & Inbound Booking Agent — US Eastern Time
description:
We are hiring a reliable, confident, and detail-oriented Appliance Repair Dispatcher and Inbound Booking Agent for a long-term remote position.



You will answer incoming calls from customers in the United States who need appliance-repair services. Your main responsibility is to qualify the customer, explain the diagnostic fee, schedule the appointment, assign or coordinate the technician, and enter complete information into our custom Repair CRM.



This is primarily an inbound-call position. There is no traditional cold calling. You may need to return missed calls and follow up with customers who requested service.



Work Schedule

Full-Time

Monday through Friday

7:00 AM – 6:00 PM (US Eastern Time)

50 scheduled hours per week

Night shift in the Philippines

Must be available during the entire shift

No overlapping full-time employment



We are looking for someone who can commit long-term and be available during our business hours without interruptions.



Voice Recording Instructions



Please record yourself reading this customer-service script naturally:



“Thank you for calling. I’m sorry to hear that your refrigerator is not cooling. I’ll ask you a few quick questions so I can check our technician’s availability. May I have your full name, phone number, and complete service address, including the ZIP code? We have a diagnostic service fee that covers the technician’s visit and inspection. I’ll explain the fee and available appointment times before confirming your booking.”



Do not use artificial intelligence or a computer-generated voice.



Application Questions



Answer these questions in your application:



How many years of phone customer-service or dispatch experience do you have?

Have you handled calls for a U.S. home-service company?

How would you explain a $100 diagnostic fee to a customer who says it is too expensive?

What would you do if a customer wants an appointment, but no technician is available in that time slot?

What information should always be collected before booking an appliance-repair appointment?

What would you do if a customer gives an incomplete address?

How do you stay organized when several calls and technician updates happen at the same time?

What is your backup plan if your internet or electricity stops working?

When can you begin?

Why are you interested in a long-term position with our company?

Hiring Process



Selected applicants will complete:



Application review

Short voice interview

Mock appliance-repair customer call

CRM data-entry test

Paid trial period

Final long-term offer



We are looking for someone dependable who wants to grow with the company—not someone seeking a temporary position.

title: Executive & Operations VA (Marketplace + E-commerce Experience Required)
description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE



This is a personal VA role supporting an individual entrepreneur across multiple ventures: watch trading, furniture reselling, monstera/plant sales, and a patches & pins e-commerce brand. The person you're supporting moves fast, has high standards, and is deeply invested in each business — this is not a corporate inbox management job.



We are looking for someone who has actually done marketplace selling work before — real listings, real buyers, real inventory. You'll be trusted with all three from day one. The goal is to remove the principal from the repetitive parts of the workflow so they can focus on sourcing, strategy, and growth.



Important: this role requires excellent, stable internet and a professional video-call setup. You'll be on regular check-in calls and occasionally client-facing. If your connection drops or you can't present yourself clearly on camera, this is not the right role — please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Watches — Core Workflow

• Add newly purchased watches to the CRM and iCloud inventory folder with complete, accurate details

• Prepare watch descriptions using provided templates and research (history, specifications, model context)

• Upload listings to Chrono24, Grailzee Pro, eBay, and the Shopify website — images, descriptions, pricing

• Monitor and reply to buyer inquiries using approved message templates; escalate non-standard situations

• Perform weekly price checks: review recent sold comps, update CRM with current market notes

• Flag watches needing service or authentication and move them to the correct stage in the CRM workflow

• Keep folder structure and CRM diligently updated — every piece accounted for, every status current



Furniture & Plants

• List and relist furniture on Craigslist,
 Marketplace, and OfferUp — write descriptions, set pricing, upload photos

• Manage buyer messages, schedule pickups, and follow the reply templates provided

• Apply the same rhythm and discipline to succulents/plants and Squarespace site updates as needed



Patches & Pins — National Park Distribution Push

• Research management companies that operate gift shops inside national park visitor centers

• Build a contact database: company names, buyer contacts, distribution center info

• Draft and send outreach using approved templates; track responses and follow-up cadence



Social Media & Content

• Post to Instagram,
, and TikTok from a provided image/video library

• Draft captions and post copy using ChatGPT/Claude based on brand voice guidelines

• Research watch brand and model histories for blog-style write-ups and social content



Photography & Research Support (As Needed)

• Follow the established photo editing workflow: watermarking, cropping, light adjustments

• Conduct structured research projects and scheduled outreach with reliable follow-up



YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF YOU...

• Have 3+ years of hands-on experience selling or managing listings on real marketplaces (eBay,
 Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp, Shopify, Chrono24, or similar) — tell us which ones and what you sold

• Have personally managed inventory records and buyer communication — not just data entry

• Are detail-obsessed: you notice the wrong file name, the stale CRM status, the price that's off by $50

• Write clear, professional English and can represent a premium brand to buyers

• Use AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude) as a productivity layer, with a human check before anything ships

• Have a fast, WIRED internet connection with a backup option, and a quiet space with a quality camera and mic for video calls

• Are engaged and present on camera — our screening includes a video, and we're watching for energy and professionalism, not just answers



IN YOUR APPLICATION, PLEASE INCLUDE:

1. The marketplaces you've personally sold or listed on, and roughly how many listings you've managed

2. One product category you know well (watches a big plus — but furniture, collectibles, or plants count too)

3. Your internet speed (download/upload) and whether it's wired

4. Please add Rockstar in your Message.



POTENTIAL TO GROW INTO

• Full ownership of the listing and inventory operation across all ventures

• Managing the photography and content pipeline

• Coordinating future hires (photographers, editors, other VAs)

GALLEON

title: Amazon Marketing Specialist — New ASIN Launches, A+ Content, PPC
description:
Amazon Marketing Specialist — New ASIN Launches, A+ Content, PPC

Alpine Provisions ·







PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING. There are specific application instructions inside. Applications that ignore them will not be reviewed. We are not trying to be difficult — we just want to work with people who read carefully, because this job requires it.





About us

Alpine Provisions is a premium men's personal care brand — body wash, shampoo, conditioner, and hand soap — built around mountain-derived botanicals and sophisticated fragrance. Cedar and sandalwood. Fir and sage. Rosemary and mint.



Amazon is our primary revenue channel. We also sell direct through Shopify.



Our founder spent 25 years in natural personal care before starting this brand, and the line relaunching this fall is the culmination of that work: new formulations, new fragrances, new packaging, and a rebuilt brand identity. We have roughly ten SKUs today across four body wash scents, three shampoos, three conditioners, plus a new exfoliating hand soap.



We are a small team on purpose — a founder, a GM, and a bench of specialist contractors. That means you will have real ownership from week one, and nobody will be micromanaging you.





The role

You own Amazon. Not "help with Amazon" — own it.



Right now our listings underperform what the products deserve. Some are undercooked. One has 252 ratings sitting under 4.0 stars and needs a real diagnosis, not guesses. We have new SKUs launching in October with a complete packaging change, which means new imagery, new copy, and new ASINs that have to come out of the gate strong rather than dying in cold-start.



That is the job. Fix what exists, launch what's coming, and run the ad account that supports both.





What you'll own

New ASIN launches

Build listings from scratch: title, bullets, backend search terms, browse node

Keyword research and competitive analysis before anything gets written

Launch strategy for cold-start ASINs — early review velocity, pricing, promotions

Variation family structure across scents and sizes so we don't fragment our review counts

Coordinate with our creative team on imagery requirements and flag what's missing

A+ content and listing optimization

Design and build A+ / Premium A+ modules that actually convert, not just fill space

Brand Story modules and Storefront build-out

Rewrite and test existing listings — copy, imagery, and structure

Diagnose underperforming SKUs: is it the main image, the price, the reviews, the traffic, or the product?

Maintain listing health and catch suppressions or content overwrites before they cost us a week

PPC

Full management of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

Campaign structure, negative keyword management, bid strategy, dayparting

Manage to a target ACoS and TACoS we agree on together, and tell us when the target is wrong

Search term report analysis on a weekly cadence

Coupons, Deals, Subscribe & Save, and Vine where they make sense

Catalog and account operations

Brand Registry, brand protection, unauthorized seller monitoring

Inventory forecasting inputs so we don't stock out on a growing SKU

Case management with Seller Support when things break

Review monitoring and flagging product issues back to the team

Reporting

Weekly: spend, ACoS, TACoS, sessions, conversion rate, organic rank movement on target keywords

Monthly: performance by SKU, what you changed, what it did, what you're testing next

We do not want a data dump. We want your read on what the numbers mean and what you plan to do about it.





Who we're looking for

Three or more years running Amazon Seller Central for real brands. Not a VA who has done some Amazon tasks. Someone who has launched ASINs and grown them.

Demonstrable PPC results. You should be able to talk about an account you took from a bad ACoS to a good one and explain exactly how.

A+ content you've actually built, not just briefed someone else to build.

Strong written English. You'll be writing listing copy that has to sound like a premium American brand, not a translation.

Comfortable with AI tools. We use them heavily for research, drafting, and analysis. Not as a replacement for your judgment — as a multiplier on it.

You tell us when we're wrong. The founder has strong opinions. He'd rather be argued with than agreed with by someone who knows better.



Nice to have: experience in personal care, beauty, or CPG. Helium 10 or Jungle Scout fluency. Experience with Amazon Attribution and external traffic. Experience with Brand Referral Bonus. Design skills for A+ modules.





How we work

Fully remote and mostly async. We ask for two to three hours of overlap with US Mountain Time so we can talk when something needs talking through, but we are not counting your hours. We care what moves.



You'll report to the GM and work directly with the founder. You'll also coordinate with our creative contractors for imagery and video, and with our Meta media team, since we run external traffic to Amazon and want the Attribution tagging done properly.



A note on how to apply: we get a lot of applications from people who mass-send the same message to fifty postings. So — put "Elevate Amazon" in your subject line. That tells us you read this far. Along with your application, send us three Amazon listings you currently manage, and point us to A+ content you personally created on those pages. We will look at them closely. Three real listings you can speak to in detail beats a long resume.



If you don't include the subject line and the three listings, we won't review the application. That's not a bluff.





Compensation

Monthly salary, paid on a schedule we'll agree on, plus a performance bonus tied to Amazon revenue growth. We'll discuss specific numbers with candidates who make it to a conversation — we'd rather pay well for someone excellent than run a race to the bottom.



Long-term role. We're building a team, not filling a gap.





To apply

Send your application with a short note about the Amazon accounts you've run and what you did with them. Skip the generic cover letter. Tell us about one listing you turned around and what specifically caused the turnaround.



We review applications weekly and respond to everyone who follows the instructions above.

title: L2 Tech Support Engineer
description:
Dear Technology Lover!

We're a small (but VERY efficient) 20-year-old MSP based in Arizona.

As a small company. we're VERY employee-focused, and believe that our team members are our MOST IMPORTANT ASSET!



Here are some of the things you can expect from working with us:

• Ongoing (monthly) manager review and feedback- you should never guess where you are "standing" and what you, AND THE COMPANY, can do better!

• Paid certifications- we will pay for your courses and tests and allocate time during business hours to help you achieve your desired goals

• Paid Time Off- it's important to us that you are happy, healthy, and have a work-life balance!

• Bonuses- when the company wins, you win!

• Raises- As we grow, we believe you should as well. We have to stay competitive as an employer to retain our awesome employees!

• Opportunities to grow- In our industry, we can't be on "cruise control"... We need to push our team members to stay ahead of the technology curve. Help you continually sharpen your skills with a focus on your career aspirations.

• Paid sick days- We understand life happens. We don't want you to feel that you have to drag yourself to work sick if your body tells you to relax...



You're the right fit if you:

• LOVE learning, working with, and experimenting with new technology

• Get excited when you save someone's day and provide great service

• Are a hard-working, fun person, and see yourself being in the IT industry for the foreseeable future

• Want to work in a GROWING environment, with STABLE income, Bonuses, and a great attitude!

• Want the opportunity to advance and learn more!



Some of the responsibilities that your position will include are:

Helpdesk (mostly escalations, but some basic if needed), cyber security related tasks/ audits, cloud hosting and virtualization (HyperV, SonicWall, VPN), MS365 management and automation, BCDR (Axcient), networking (UniFi, SonicWall), IT projects, Servers maintenance (Windows only), scripts creation, testing new technology, and other tasks related to IT.



IMPORTANT:

This position requires AT LEAST 2 years of MSP experience and at least 2 years of experience in an L2 position, supervisory, or lead role. 100% clean background check, highly organized, technologically savvy, and can work diligently with little supervision. Several hiring steps will take place to verify the above requirements, including reference checking, employment verification, technical testing, and more.



Minimum technical level that you will need to be able to pass a test on:

• Explaining to a non-technical person what the "cloud" is

• Consulting with a new client on what BCDR solution you would recommend to an SMB, and why

• Explaining what the differences are between traditional anti-virus and XDR

• Creating a new Virtual Machine on a Hyper-V host, from an ISO file located on a different computer on the network.

• Explaining the differences and commonalities between SharePoint and OneDrive.

• Creating an Intune policy that will install Firefox on an Azure-joined VM, and make Firefox the default browser, with the specific home page we'll provide to you during the test.

• Several other situational and technical questions.

• CCNA certificate candidates preferred but not required.



MORE DETAILS:

• A PRE-EMPLOYMENT BACKGROUND CHECK is performed (at our expense). You must have 100% clean background check. Please do not apply if you don't have 100% clean background check.

• Personality is KEY for us. We are looking for an easy-going, yet professional, friendly, and HONEST person.

• You will be working from home. This means you must have a quiet work environment and no excessive background noise.

• FAST AND RELIABLE INTERNET SERVICE IS REQUIRED with at least 100Mbps download speed and 20+ Mbps upload speed.

title: Senior Graphics & Packaging Designer
description:
Full-time | 40 hours/week | $2,000 USD/month + 13th Month Pay | Immediate Start



**ABOUT US**

Intent Brands owns two growing consumer brands sold through Amazon and Shopify: SurviveX, a premium first aid and emergency preparedness brand, and Aerotrunk, a premium hardside luggage brand.



**THE ROLE**

We're looking for a senior-level designer who can own the visual output of both brands, from retail packaging and Amazon A+ content to ecommerce and social media, with minimal supervision.



**What You'll Do**

-Design retail packaging, inserts, labels and production-ready artwork

-Create Amazon listing images, infographics and A+ Content

-Design Amazon Brand Store and Shopify assets

-Create social media and marketing graphics

-Retouch, composite and art-direct product imagery

-Maintain and evolve both brands' visual identities



***What We're Looking For**

We're not looking for someone who simply knows Photoshop. We want a designer with a portfolio that makes us want to hire them immediately.





***MUST HAVE**

1.) Real retail packaging experience that has gone to print

2.) Strong knowledge of dielines, bleeds, safe zones, spot colours and substrates

3.) Amazon listing and A+ Content experience

4.) Strong print-production knowledge: CMYK, Pantone, PDF/X and press-ready files

5.) Advanced Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign skills

6.) Excellent typography, layout and visual hierarchy

7.) Strong written English and ability to work independently



**BONUS/ NICE TO HAVE**

-After Effects / motion graphics

-Blender / Dimension / 3D

-Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion or similar

-Figma

-Medical or health product packaging experience

-FDA/regulatory labelling experience



***PLEASE ANSWER ALL THE FOUR QUESTIONS**

TAKE NOTE: Include the phrase "I Design For Production" of the first line your application. This tells us you've read the full listing.



IMPORTANT: Please include links to your portfolio or relevant work, along with your responses to the following questions:



QUESTION #1.) Show us two packaging project you're particularly proud of that went into physical production. 

Please tell us:

-What was the product?

-What were the print specifications and constraints? 

-What was your process from concept through final artwork? 

-Did this product include any packaging inserts, user manuals, or multi-page guides? 

-If so, show us how you prepared those layouts (e.g., using InDesign) for production.

-Can you show the physical printed product alongside your design?

**Share us the link of it. Actual printed products are strongly preferred over mockups.**



QUESTION #2.) Amazon Design Challenge

Choose one scenario:

*Option A:  Our first aid kit's main Amazon image has a 3% click-through rate, compared with a category average of 4.5%. The current image is a straightforward product shot on white.

*Option B: We're launching a new luggage product and need seven Amazon listing images.

What would you change, and why? What would you A/B test first?

What would you put in each image slot, and why?



We're interested in your thinking, not just your final design.



QUESTION #3.) Two Very Different Brands:

SurviveX is medical/tactical: red, black, authoritative and confident.

Aerotrunk is modern, premium and aspirational, with a travel/lifestyle focus.



How would you design for two very different brands without making them feel like the work of the same brand?

Give us a specific technique, process or example from your experience.



QUESTION #4.) Your Tools & Workflow

-Tell us your complete design stack.

-Specifically for Adobe InDesign: How do you use it in your packaging workflow (e.g., product inserts, user guides, multi-page manuals, or style guides)? 

--Figma: How do you incorporate Figma into your workflow (e.g., e-commerce asset planning, component libraries, UI/Shopify graphics, or collaborative layout)?

-Also tell us your typical turnaround time for creating a complete set of seven Amazon listing images, from brief to final delivery.



***SHORT-LISTED APPLICANTS WILL ADVANCED TO OUR PAID DESIGN TEST**

We believe the best way to evaluate a designer is to look at their actual work.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a paid design test ($100 USD) instead of going through multiple rounds of interviews.



The test will involve:

Redesigning three existing SurviveX Amazon listing images

Creating a front-and-back packaging insert based on a supplied dieline and brief

We'll provide the brand guidelines, existing assets and a clear brief.



We'll be evaluating: Design quality, Brand interpretation, Commercial thinking , Production readiness, Attention to detail, Turnaround speed



********WE OFFER THE BEST DEAL!!!********

SALARY: $2,000 USD/month

Paid biweekly via direct deposit.



13th Month Pay: Standard Philippine benefit.

Paid Time Off: Philippine holidays plus 15 days of personal leave.



Creative Ownership: You'll have genuine influence over how two growing brands look and communicate.

Small, Direct Team: You'll work closely with the founders without layers of middle management.

Room to Grow: As the brands grow, there's potential to progress into a Design Lead or Creative Director role.



***HOW TO APPLY***

Please include all of the following:

Answers to all four screening questions

The phrase "I design for production"

A link to your portfolio

At least two examples of physical product packaging you designed

Your expected rate and availability



Your portfolio can be on Behance, Dribbble, your own website, Google Drive or another platform. We care about the work, not where you host it.



**Applications without a portfolio or completed screening questions will not be reviewed.**

We aim to review applications within 48 hours. Shortlisted candidates will receive the paid design test within one week.



THANK YOU AND WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO SEE YOUR APPLICATIONS!

Our company operates with high standards, strong systems, and a commitment to fully training and supporting team members for long-term success.



This is a full-time role with complete training provided. You will work directly with our Head of Growth to support our marketing across SEO, paid ads, influencers, affiliates, and reporting. You will help keep our campaigns organized, our content optimized, and our data accurate.



If you enjoy structured work, staying organized, and digital marketing, this role is a great long-term opportunity.



## Compensation + Schedule



- $1,300 USD per month

- Full-time: 40 hours per week

- Equivalent to $8.125/hour

- Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Yearly Salary Increases & Bonus

- Full Training Provided



## How To Apply (IMPORTANT)



The ONLY way to apply is through this link:



** => 
/s/apb4look **



You must complete the assessment (takes up to 43 minutes max).



Your resume MUST be submitted through that link. Applications sent any other way will not be considered.



## Why We Require This Test



We receive hundreds of applicants, and resumes alone don't tell us who is truly smart, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems independently.



This assessment is the fastest and fairest way for us to filter applicants based on cognitive aptitude (how quickly you learn, follow instructions, and troubleshoot issues). That matters a lot in marketing work where accuracy and follow-through are everything.



If you do well, you'll be prioritized for a long-term, full-time role with $1,100/month pay, PTO, and full training.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



### 1) SEO Support



- Assist with recurring technical SEO audits and maintain an issue tracker

- Help optimize product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and blogs

- Conduct keyword research and update titles, metadata, headings, internal links, alt text, and page copy

- Review blog and product content for search intent, structure, and SEO best practices

- Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and indexing



### 2) AI Search Optimization (AEO)



- Optimize content so our brand shows up in AI search, voice search, and answer engines (ChatGPT, Google AI results, etc.)

### 3) Paid Media Creative Operations

- Track asset status, revisions, approvals, usage rights, and delivery dates

### 5) Influencer & Affiliate Support

- Track deliverables, content status, links, codes, commissions, and performance

### 6) Reporting



- Support weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing reports

- Gather data from Shopify, GA4, ad platforms, SEO tools, and creator/affiliate platforms

- Update dashboards and track metrics like revenue, ROAS, CPA, AOV, and conversion rate

- Flag data discrepancies, unusual trends, risks, and opportunities

- Help write short summaries of performance and next steps



## What We're Looking For



- Strong written English (near-native)

- 2–5 years of experience in digital marketing, ecommerce, SEO, content, influencer, or affiliate marketing

- Highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and trackers
