title: Remote Operations Coordinator & Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
U.S. Home Service / Painting Company | Full-Time Remote



We are a growing U.S.-based painting company looking for a highly organized, proactive Remote Operations Coordinator to become a key part of our day-to-day operations.



This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, solve problems, communicate professionally with customers and crews, and make sure jobs move smoothly from the moment they are sold through final payment and a 5-star review.



The right person will also be responsible for quickly responding to leads from one specific lead source and converting those leads into scheduled estimates on our calendar.



Lead Conversion



You will be responsible for managing leads from a designated lead source.

Responsibilities include:



-Respond quickly to every new lead during designated business hours

-Call and text leads to establish contact

-Follow up consistently with leads who do not initially respond

-Qualify the opportunity and schedule estimates on our sales calendar

-Keep accurate records of every lead and its current status

-Track lead-to-estimate conversion rate

-Work to continually improve the percentage of leads converted into appointments



This role requires someone who is comfortable on the phone, persistent without being pushy, and motivated by results.



Sold Job ? Installation Ownership



Once one of our sales representatives sells an estimate and converts it into a job, you take ownership of coordinating the job through installation and completion.



You will:



-Review every newly sold job for accuracy and completeness

-Confirm the initial deposit has been collected

-Communicate with the customer after the sale

-Obtain paint/color selections

-Confirm job details and expected timing

-Upload jobs into HeyPros

-Coordinate subcontractor bidding and assignment

-Assign the appropriate subcontractor or in-house painter

-Coordinate availability between the customer, subcontractors and our in-house painters

-Establish and confirm job start dates

-Make sure everyone involved knows where they need to be and when

-Keep the job schedule and CRM completely up to date



Job Planning & Production



You will help determine what each project should require before it begins.



This includes:



-Reviewing the scope of work

-Determining the expected number of man-days

-Estimating expected labor requirements

-Reviewing expected material and paint costs

-Making sure jobs are set up to meet our gross-profit targets

-Identifying potential issues before production begins

-Making sure the assigned crew understands the scope

-Confirming paint and materials are ready for the project

-Keeping jobs moving according to schedule



You don't need to physically know how to paint, but you must be willing to learn how a professional painting company operates so you can understand labor, materials, production timelines and job profitability.



Customer Communication



You will become the customer's main point of contact after the sale so our sales representatives can remain focused on selling.



You will:



-Introduce yourself after the project is sold

-Keep customers informed about scheduling and next steps

-Answer routine questions

-Coordinate colors, start dates and project logistics

-Handle concerns professionally

-Communicate with crews when customers need something

-Escalate issues to management when necessary

-Make customers feel that someone is actively managing their project



Our goal is for the customer to always know who to contact and what happens next.



Payments & Job Completion



You will make sure the administrative and financial side of every job is completed properly.



This includes:



-Confirming initial deposits are received before scheduling

-Tracking outstanding customer balances

-Making sure final invoices are sent

-Following up until final payment is collected

-Confirming jobs are properly closed out in our systems

-Following up with customers after completion

-Asking satisfied customers for a 5-star review

-Tracking review results



CRM & Operations Management



You will help keep the entire operation organized.



Responsibilities include:



-Maintaining accurate information in Housecall Pro

-Maintaining job and lead tracking spreadsheets

-Keeping customer information, job statuses and schedules current

-Making sure no sold job or customer request falls through the cracks

-Tracking deposits, balances, start dates, completion dates and reviews

-Communicating with sales representatives, painters and subcontractors

-Following company SOPs and checklists

-Identifying problems before they become emergencies



Helping management improve processes as the company grows



Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is:



-Extremely organized

-Excellent at written and spoken English

-Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone

-Comfortable making outbound calls

-Strong at converting leads into appointments

-Detail-oriented

-Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

-Comfortable managing multiple jobs at the same time

-Good at solving scheduling problems

-Comfortable holding people accountable

-Professional with customers

-Comfortable working with spreadsheets and CRMs

-Able to learn new software quickly

-Comfortable working independently

-Motivated by measurable results

-Looking for a long-term position with a growing company



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



-Home-service companies

-Painting or construction

-Roofing, HVAC, plumbing or remodeling

-Project coordination

-Operations management

-Dispatching or scheduling

-Lead conversion / appointment setting

-Customer service

-Housecall Pro

-HeyPros

-Google Sheets / Excel



How Success Will Be Measured



Your performance will be measured by results, including:



-Lead-to-estimate conversion rate

-Speed of response to new leads

-Accuracy of Housecall Pro and job records

-Jobs scheduled without unnecessary delays

-Accurate coordination of customers and crews

-Job labor and material planning

-Deposits collected before scheduling

-Final balances collected promptly

-Customer communication and satisfaction

-Percentage of completed jobs resulting in 5-star reviews

-Number of operational problems caught and solved before they affect the customer



The Person Who Will Excel in This Position



We are looking for someone who eventually knows the status of our operation without the owner needing to ask.



-If a customer hasn't selected colors, you are following up.

-If a deposit hasn't been paid, you know about it.

-If a subcontractor hasn't confirmed a start date, you're contacting them.

-If a job doesn't have enough information, you're getting it.

-If a crew is running behind, you're coordinating the schedule.

-If a final balance is outstanding, you're following up.

-If a happy customer hasn't left a review, you're asking for one.

-And when a new lead comes in, you're working to get that opportunity onto our estimate calendar.



The goal of this position is simple:



Keep the operation organized, keep customers informed, keep crews scheduled, keep jobs moving, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We want someone who takes genuine ownership of that responsibility and wants to grow with the company long-term.

title: Senior Paid Media & Digital Growth Manager — Meta Ads
description:
30 hours per week | 6 hours/day, Monday–Friday



About Endorfix



Endorfix is a fast-moving consumer wellness brand selling across the United States and international markets. We sell primarily through DTC ecommerce while also developing retail, distributor and international growth channels.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Paid Media & Digital Growth Manager to take day-to-day ownership of our Meta advertising and help drive profitable customer acquisition.



This is not a junior media-buying role and it is not a position where you simply follow instructions and push buttons.



We want someone capable of owning the account operationally, identifying what is working, identifying what is wasting money, making informed optimisation decisions and bringing recommendations to the CEO.



What you'll own



You will have primary day-to-day responsibility for the operation and optimisation of Endorfix's paid social acquisition, particularly Meta.



Your responsibilities will include:



Managing the daily operation of our Meta Ads account

Building, launching and maintaining campaigns, ad sets and advertisements

Monitoring campaign performance, spend, CAC, CPA, ROAS and conversion performance

Scaling winning campaigns and reducing or pausing underperforming spend within agreed commercial guardrails

Managing campaign budgets and pacing against approved monthly and weekly budgets

Testing campaign structures, audiences, placements, offers and creative combinations

Maintaining appropriate account structure and avoiding unnecessary campaign fragmentation

Reviewing performance throughout the week and making optimisation decisions without waiting to be instructed on every change

Identifying creative fatigue and recommending new creative angles

Preparing clear creative briefs based on actual advertising performance

Working with our internal/external creative resources to develop new ads, hooks, iterations and variations

Coordinating the upload, naming, organisation and deployment of new advertising assets

Analysing landing-page and funnel performance alongside advertising performance

Reviewing attribution and performance data across Meta, Shopify and other relevant analytics platforms

Producing a concise weekly growth report covering spend, revenue, CAC/CPA, ROAS, winners, losers, changes made, tests underway and recommended next actions

Maintaining a written record of significant campaign changes and the commercial reasoning behind them

Identifying problems proactively rather than waiting for the CEO to find them

Working with other digital specialists or agencies where required

The level of ownership we're looking for



We are specifically looking for someone who can become the company's paid acquisition operator, rather than an assistant to somebody else running the account.



The CEO will continue to set the broader commercial strategy, including overall growth objectives, acceptable acquisition economics, major budget allocation, geographic priorities, new market entry, channel strategy and significant changes in investment.



You will be responsible for translating those objectives into the day-to-day operation of paid acquisition.



If Meta performance deteriorates on a Tuesday, we don't want someone waiting until Friday's meeting to be told what to look at.



We want someone who investigates it, understands what changed, takes appropriate action within their authority and explains what they did and why.



You should have

5+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience, ideally in ecommerce/DTC

Experience personally managing meaningful advertising budgets

Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, campaign architecture, optimisation and scaling

Demonstrable experience improving CAC, CPA and ROAS

Strong understanding of creative testing and how creative performance affects paid acquisition

Experience interpreting Shopify/ecommerce conversion data

Confidence making day-to-day optimisation decisions independently

Strong written English and the ability to explain performance without hiding behind dashboards

Strong commercial judgement — we're much more interested in profitable growth than vanity metrics

Excellent attention to detail



Experience with Shopify,
 marketing, GA4, and attribution/reporting tools is highly regarded.



What we're not looking for



This isn't the right role if your experience is primarily boosting posts, scheduling organic social content or simply producing weekly Meta reports.



We also aren't looking for someone who needs the founder to tell them which ads to switch off, what campaign to create next or where to look when performance changes.



We're hiring expertise because we want expertise.



Hours



This is a long-term remote position based in the Philippines.



6 hours per day

5 days per week

Approximately 30 hours per week

Monday to Friday

Mostly flexible working hours, with regular agreed overlap with the Austin, Texas team



There will be a weekly strategy/performance meeting with the CEO, but the role is expected to operate independently between meetings.



To apply



Please don't send us a generic cover letter.



Instead, send:



A short summary of your Meta advertising experience.

The approximate monthly ad budgets you have personally managed.

Two examples where you materially improved campaign performance and what you actually changed.

An anonymised screenshot or report demonstrating results from an account you personally managed, if permitted.



Please start your application with the words “I pull the levers” so we know you've read the full advertisement.

About the Role

Behind every successful outbound campaign is a high-quality contact list, and that’s where you come in.



As our List Building Specialist, you’ll be responsible for researching, validating, and maintaining prospect lists that fuel our outbound campaigns. This isn’t a basic data-entry job. We’re looking for someone technical, detail-oriented, and AI-savvy, someone who can combine deep research with automation and AI tools to deliver accurate, scalable data.

Key Responsibilities

- Technical Integrations: Set up and manage API connections within Clay and other enrichment platforms to expand data coverage.

- ICP Alignment: Work closely with Account Managers to refine targeting criteria and ensure list quality supports campaign goals.

- Quality Control: Verify accuracy, eliminate duplicates, and ensure lists meet agency standards.

What We’re Looking For

- At least 1 year of experience in list building, lead research, or data enrichment (B2B sales/lead gen experience preferred).

- Strong technical ability — able to set up API integrations and troubleshoot workflows in tools like Clay.

- Highly interested with AI tools and eager to adopt new AI-driven workflows.

- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar tools.

- Proficiency in managing and maintaining databases in Supabase and HubSpot.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (Google Sheets, Excel).

- Sharp attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

- Quick learner, independent, and resourceful — able to deliver without heavy oversight.

- Previous experience with enrichment tools (Forager, Prospeo, ContactOut, IcyPeas) is highly preferred.

s and action items

title: AMAZON ADVERTISING GROWTH MANAGER Health & Household | Remote | Part-Time
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY



We are a growing e-commerce company with proven products in the Amazon Health & Household category.



This product line has already generated more than $100,000 per month in sales. We are now relaunching it on a new Amazon account and plan to scale aggressively.



The demand already exists. Your job is to build the advertising system that captures it profitably.



You will work directly with the owner inside a small company that moves quickly. We care about getting the right campaigns launched, learning from the numbers and making intelligent decisions quickly.



We are not looking for someone to simply monitor campaigns or change bids when asked. We want an experienced operator who can understand the goal, build the strategy and bring us recommended solutions—not just problems.



YOUR MISSION



Build and manage an Amazon PPC system that profitably relaunches and scales our proven Health & Household products.



Your first priority will be setting up several campaigns this weekend, so you must be available to begin immediately.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE



Within your first 72 hours:



* Understand our products, margins, previous performance and objectives

* Establish initial ACOS, TACoS and profitability targets

* Build and launch the priority campaigns

* Create a simple scoreboard showing whether we are moving in the right direction



Within your first 30 days:



* Establish a clean, scalable campaign structure

* Identify converting keywords and product targets

* Eliminate obvious wasted spending

* Increase qualified traffic and sales

* Provide clear recommendations based on the data

* Show us exactly what is working, what is not working and what should happen next



WHAT YOU’LL OWN



* Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display when appropriate

* Keyword, competitor and product-targeting research

* Campaign structure, bids, budgets and placements

* Search-term harvesting and negative targeting

* CTR, CPC, conversion rate, ACOS, TACoS and contribution profitability

* Scaling successful campaigns without losing control of efficiency

* Diagnosing whether performance problems come from advertising, pricing, the listing, reviews or another conversion issue

* Short weekly updates focused on results, lessons and next actions



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You must have personally managed at least $50,000 per month in Amazon PPC ad spend—not merely an account generating $50,000 in sales.



The right person:



* Has proven Amazon PPC results at meaningful scale

* Understands the Health & Household category

* Thinks in terms of profit and total account growth—not ACOS alone

* Makes decisions using data without waiting for perfect information

* Takes responsibility when something does not work

* Can move quickly without becoming careless



COMPENSATION AND ROLE DETAILS

* Potential to grow into a full-time position if your results demonstrate that you are an A player



HOW TO APPLY



Message me at +1 (615)
if interested.

title: Local SEO Specialist (WordPress) — Map Pack + AI Overviews — Full Time
description:
We manage a portfolio of 100+ WordPress lead generation websites in the US local services market. Every site targets its own city and needs to rank locally — Map Pack, local organic, and now inside Google's AI Overviews.



We're looking for one person to own local SEO across this portfolio. This is not a one-off project. It's a long-term seat with steady work, and the right person will grow into managing their own team as we scale.



Important: with 100+ sites, this role is about systems, not hand-crafting one site at a time. If you think in templates, batches, checklists, and spreadsheets, you'll do well here. If you can only work site-by-site, this will overwhelm you.



What you'll be doing



On-Page SEO



Title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 structure, internal linking across city and service pages

Keyword mapping — one primary intent per page, no cannibalization between city pages

Building and improving city + service landing pages at scale

Image optimization: alt text, file naming, compression, geo-relevance

Local business schema, service schema, FAQ schema



Technical SEO



Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile usability

Crawl and index management — sitemaps, robots,txt, canonicals, redirects

Fixing broken links, orphan pages, thin and duplicate content

Regular technical audits across the portfolio with prioritized fix lists



Content



Rewriting and upgrading existing page content so it actually reads like a local business wrote it — not generic AI filler

Service pages, city pages, FAQs, blog posts

Sourcing and replacing stock-looking photos with images that fit the local market

You'll have AI tools available, but we expect edited, human-quality output. We can tell the difference.



Off-Page SEO



Citation building and cleanup — NAP consistency across all directories

Google Business Profile optimization: categories, services, descriptions, posts, photos, Q&A, review strategy

Local link building — niche directories, local sponsorships, relevant outreach

Monitoring and cleaning up bad or spammy backlinks



AI Search / AI Overviews



Structuring content so it gets pulled into AI Overviews and AI-generated answers

Direct-answer formatting, question-based headings, entity clarity, strong schema

Tracking which queries our sites appear in across AI results and adjusting

Staying current — this area changes fast and we want someone who follows it closely



Reporting



Weekly progress updates in a shared tracker

Rank tracking by city and keyword

Monthly summary: what moved, what didn't, what's next

What we're looking for

3+ years of hands-on local SEO — real Map Pack and local organic results, not just theory

Strong WordPress working knowledge — Elementor or similar page builders, plugin management, comfortable making changes without breaking a site

Solid grasp of Google Business Profile optimization and local ranking factors

Experience with US-based local businesses specifically

Excellent written English — you'll be writing customer-facing content

Comfortable working across many sites at once using systems and repeatable processes

Self-directed. You'll get direction and priorities, but we're not going to manage every task.

Reliable daily availability with at least a few hours overlapping US business hours

Nice to have (not required)

WordPress design skills — page layouts, theme customization, redesigning outdated sites

Basic HTML/CSS

Experience with  BrightLocal, Whitespark, Ahrefs, or SEMrush

Experience running or supervising a small SEO team

Any experience in the auto transport, moving, or home services niches



What we provide



All tool subscriptions and software licenses

Clear priorities, templates, and existing processes to build on

Long-term stable work — we've been doing this for years and we're growing



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip these steps get deleted. This is our first filter.



1. Put this exact phrase in your subject line: LOCAL-100 SEO



2. Answer these four questions in your application:



Give one website you personally worked on that ranks in the Map Pack. Include the city and the keyword it ranks for.

A client's Google Business Profile ranks #1 in the Map Pack, but their website doesn't show up in local organic results for the same keyword. What are the first three things you check?

You need to update title tags and add schema across 100 WordPress sites. Walk us through how you'd approach it — realistically, in a way that doesn't take six months.

What is one thing you've changed about how you do SEO in the last 12 months because of AI Overviews?



3. Tell us your expected monthly rate and your available hours in Philippine time.



Short, direct answers are fine. We care about how you think, not how long your application is.



Thanks for reading — we look forward to hearing from you.
